title: Art Director
description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

**About the Role:**
===================

As Art Director, you will set the design vision for Labhouse and be accountable for the quality and impact of the experience across our whole app portfolio. Working as a direct partner to the CEO and Head of Product, you will decide how design is done in the company: the standards, the process, the team and the level of craft that sets our apps apart.

This is a leadership role with **deep craft and hands-on work**. You will set the strategy and build the design team, and still step in on the work that matters most, from defining a new app's concept to reviewing the final pixels, animations and store assets. You will own the design system across all products, make sure every launch meets a best-in-class bar, and tie design decisions directly to business results: activation, retention, conversion and store performance.

**What you'll own:**
====================

* **Design vision and strategy:** define the UI/UX principles, visual language and quality bar for the whole portfolio, and bring them to every product decision at leadership level.
* **0 1 launches:** lead the experience for new apps from concept to launch, including research, benchmarking, prototyping and validation with real users.
* **Craft and production quality:** set the standard for every asset we ship: UI, illustrations, icons, motion, animations, store screenshots and videos, and make sure what engineering ships matches what was designed.
* **Measurable design impact:** work with Product and Data to turn onboarding, paywall, core flow and store-asset improvements into measurable gains in activation, conversion, retention and store conversion rate.
* **Design system at scale:** own a portfolio-wide design system that lets us launch new apps faster while keeping consistency and craft.
* **AI-native design workflows:** introduce AI tools into research, ideation, asset creation and prototyping to multiply the team's output.
* **Build and scale design teams**: hiring, mentoring and developing senior talent.

**About You:**
==============

**Craft and technical expertise:**

* Solid track record in product, UX/UI, or visual design, including leading design teams or a design function.
* Experience leading the design of consumer mobile apps from scratch to scale (ideally millions of users), with clear business impact you can quantify.
* A portfolio that shows both exceptional craft and strategic thinking: from early concepts to shipped, high-performing products.
* An artistic eye for color, composition, typography and motion, able to lead and review any type of asset.
* Mastery of Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, and the ability to jump in hands-on.
* Deep knowledge of iOS and Android design guidelines, and of how to go beyond them to create distinctive experiences.

**Product and business focus:**

* Experience owning design strategy at leadership level and influencing founders and executives on product direction.
* A product-first mindset: you think in user problems, hypotheses and outcomes, not just screens.
* Comfortable working with data: you use analytics, A/B tests and store metrics to guide and defend design decisions.
* Strong understanding of consumer app monetization (subscriptions, paywalls, onboarding) and how design moves it.
* Self-driven and entrepreneurial, with high ownership and comfort working directly with founders in a fast-paced environment.

**Communication:**

* Fluent in spoken and written English
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and marketing.

**Nice to Have:**
=================

* Experience in a portfolio or app studio model, managing design across several products at the same time.

**What we Offer:**
==================

* Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week.
* Flexible working hours.
* Permanent contract with competitive compensation.
* High-end equipment for your development.
* A top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment.
* Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps.

**Hiring Process**
==================

* **TA Interview** – Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.
* **CEO** – Deep dive into your product thinking, design experience, and fit with the team.
* **Technical Case** – Practical exercise to assess your product, analytical, and strategic capabilities.
* **Final Interview** – Final conversation to ensure alignment on expectations, culture, and role fit.

**You should Know:**
====================

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
**About Social Scout**

Social Scout is the fastest-growing retention agency in the eCommerce industry, helping DTC brands generate more repeat purchases and increase customer lifetime value through email and SMS marketing.

We currently work with 150+ full-service retainer client accounts and are rapidly expanding into conversion rate optimization (CRO) and webpage design services.

We’re hiring a prolific, high-velocity Creative Strategist to lead our internal client acquisition pipeline. Managing over $110,000/month in internal Meta ad spend, your primary objective will be to conceptualize, script, launch, and scale high-converting B2B ad campaigns that convince eCommerce founders, CMOs, and heads of growth to hire Social Scout.

Our goal is simple: book more qualified calls, sign more clients, and accelerate our growth even further. We want to double, and eventually triple, our current ad spend as quickly as performance allows.

This role will initially focus heavily on scaling our core email and SMS marketing offer, while also helping us expand into new acquisition funnels for CRO and related services.

We’re looking for someone who can operate at high velocity, aiming for 60+ ad variations per week, while still thinking strategically about messaging, hooks, angles, creative formats, testing, and performance.

**Compensation & Role Details**

* Highly competitive salary.
* Full-time (40 hours per week) and fully remote.
* You must be set up and hired as a contractor.
* Fluent English required (written and spoken).
* A minimum five hour overlap between 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.

**The Role**

As a Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of creative concepts, rapid content production, and ad account execution. You won't just be writing briefs, you will actively write scripts, direct existing video footage (studio recordings, founder clips, B-roll, client interviews), manage UGC creator relationships, collaborate with video editors, and directly launch campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager.

This is a high-volume, performance-first role built for someone who understands how to use creative as the primary targeting lever in B2B and performance marketing.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* High-Velocity Scripting & Concepting: Develop 60 ad creative concepts/variations weekly using modular testing frameworks (swapping hooks, CTAs, angles, and visual formats) tailored for Meta.
* Content & Production Management: Utilize our existing media library (founder studio footage, client interviews, B-roll) to brief video editors. Sourcing and managing relationships with external UGC creators and B2B actors as needed.
* Meta Campaign Setup & Launch: Upload, set up, and launch ad creatives directly inside Meta Ads Manager, ensuring accurate naming conventions, headlines, primary text, and campaign setups.
* Performance Analysis & Testing: Analyze front-end metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPL) and down-funnel performance. Continually iterate on winning angles and eliminate underperforming creative assets.
* Service Ecosystem Synergy: Work closely with our email marketing and upcoming CRO/webpage design teams to ensure ad messaging seamlessly connects with landing pages and backend nurture flows.
* Platform Expansion Strategy: Lead initial efforts on Meta while laying the foundation to repurpose winning creative formats into future channels like LinkedIn and Google.

### **What You Bring**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience as a Performance Creative Strategist focused heavily on Meta Ads.
* Proven track record writing scripts and concepts for short-form video (Reels/UGC) and static graphics that drive direct-response conversions.
* Experience in high-volume creative testing environments, capable of managing asset pipelines and briefing video editors efficiently.
* Hands-on proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, including campaign creation, ad upload, ad copy execution, and metric tracking.
* Strong understanding of creative analytics: You know how to read Hook Rates (3-second view rates), Hold Rates, and CTRs to diagnose why an ad is winning or losing.
* Organized workflow management: Comfortable managing raw footage libraries, creator briefs, and editing queues without letting details slip through the cracks.

### **Who You Are**

* A natural storyteller who understands psychology: You know how to stop the scroll, address pain points, and communicate complex value propositions clearly and persuasively.
* Data-driven and volume-minded: You understand that scaling on Meta requires constant creative iteration and rapid testing rather than relying on a single "perfect" ad.
* Detail-obsessed: From ad copy formatting and UTM links to upload settings in Meta Ads Manager, you hold high standards for accuracy and quality assurance.
* Proactive and execution-focused: You don't wait for footage to be delivered—you review existing raw assets, pull client interviews, write scripts, and push campaigns live efficiently.

### **Why Social Scout?**

* High-impact position: Own the flagship creative production process driving $110k+/month in Meta ad spend across a growing portfolio of 150+ clients.
* Access to strong creative assets: Work with dedicated studio footage, head of growth recordings, client interviews, and in-house video editing support.
* Career growth: Opportunity to shape and lead our expanding paid social department as we scale into new platforms (LinkedIn, Google) and offer cross-channel CRO services.
* A fast-moving, supportive culture: Collaborative environment with proven marketers who celebrate wins and value performance-driven creativity.

title: Creative Director, Marketing

* Expert-level, hands-on skills in short-form video: hooks, storytelling, pacing, editing and platform-native formats.
* An artistic eye for color, composition, typography and motion, able to create and review any type of asset: Video ads, motion graphics, static and carousel ads, App Store assets (icons, screenshots, preview videos), social content and creator briefs, brand identity and campaign concepts

* Strong understanding of mobile app growth and brands: user acquisition, the subscription funnel, and how creative drives it.

* Comfortable working with data. You read ad dashboards, creative analytics and A/B test results to guide and defend creative decisions.
* Experience mentoring creatives and managing freelancers and creators.

**Communication:**

* Fluent in spoken and written English.
* Able to pitch creative ideas in a compelling way, write clear briefs, and give direct, constructive feedback to the team.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including UX, engineering, product, and marketing.

**Nice to Have:**
=================

* Experience in a portfolio or app studio model, running creative for several products at the same time.

**What we Offer:**
==================

* Flexible working hours.
* Competitive compensation
* High-end equipment for your development.
* A top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment.
* Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps.

title: Performance Creative Strategist — Freelance
description:
**Modalidad: Freelance · 100% remoto (España / UE, horario CET)**

**Idiomas: español nativo o profesional · inglés fluido**

### **Sobre el rol**

En Ironhack buscamos un/a Performance Creative Strategist freelance que combine pensamiento creativo, copywriting y estrategia orientada a performance. Alguien que entienda la publicidad digital desde la idea hasta el resultado: que sepa identificar un insight, convertirlo en un concepto creativo potente y traducirlo en anuncios capaces de captar la atención, generar interés y convertir.

Trabajarás mano a mano con nuestra diseñadora gráfica para convertir las ideas en creatividades listas para testear, aprender y escalar. La autonomía y el criterio creativo son clave: esperamos que detectes la oportunidad, desarrolles la idea y des una dirección clara a diseño hasta su ejecución.

### **Tus responsabilidades**

* Performance creative y copywriting: desarrollarás conceptos, hooks, headlines, body copy y CTAs orientados a conversión, partiendo de los pain points y motivaciones de nuestra audiencia (cambio de carrera, empleabilidad, progresión profesional). Serás responsable del criterio creativo y estratégico final.
* Conectar datos y creatividad: junto al equipo de Marketing, usarás métricas como CTR, CPA, CVR y frecuencia para detectar oportunidades y convertirlas en nuevas hipótesis, ángulos, formatos y variaciones creativas.
* Dirección creativa y briefing: no necesitas ser diseñador/a, pero sí tener un criterio visual y publicitario sólido. Crearás briefs y/o wireframes que indiquen qué debe comunicar la pieza, qué debe captar la atención, cuál es la jerarquía del mensaje y qué elementos deben destacar. Darás feedback y dirigirás las iteraciones hasta llegar a la creatividad final.
* Creative research e innovación: investigarás de forma continua la Meta Ad Library, TikTok y otras fuentes para identificar tendencias, formatos y oportunidades, analizando competidores directos e indirectos y siempre respetando nuestro Brandbook y posicionamiento.
* Project management: gestionarás el proceso creativo de principio a fin: planificación de ideas, briefs, coordinación con diseño, seguimiento de entregables y preparación de los assets finales para su lanzamiento, cumpliendo los plazos acordados.

### **Lo que buscamos**

* Creative thinking y performance copywriting — Prioridad #1. Generas ideas publicitarias originales que destacan en un feed saturado y sabes explicar por qué deberían funcionar, qué insight explotan y cómo se pueden testear. Tu portfolio demuestra publicidad digital orientada a performance, no solo piezas visualmente atractivas.
* Project management — Prioridad #2. Eres una persona organizada, metódica y autónoma en remoto. Sabes estructurar proyectos, gestionar prioridades y coordinar a otros perfiles para entregar a tiempo.
* Experiencia demostrable en creative strategy para Meta Ads, idealmente en entornos de performance marketing.
* Criterio creativo y atención al detalle. Trabajas dentro de unos Brand Guidelines y Value Propositions definidos sin perder la capacidad de proponer ideas nuevas y diferenciadoras.
* Orientación a resultados. Quieres entender por qué funciona una creatividad y usas los resultados de cada test para alimentar la siguiente ronda de ideas.
* Idiomas: español nativo o profesional para escribir copy; inglés fluido.

### **Será valorable**

* Experiencia en agencia de publicidad
* Experiencia con funnels de adquisición y lead generation.
* Conocimientos básicos de CapCut (edición de vídeo) y Figma.
* Experiencia creando o participando en contenido UGC.

### **Proceso de selección**

* Candidatura: responde a las preguntas de selección e incluye el link a tu portfolio en tu CV.
* Caso práctico: te lo enviaremos por email (45–60 min de trabajo estimado).
* Entrevista: defensa del caso práctico y revisión de un proyecto real de tu portfolio y sus resultados.

### **Portfolio**

Para valorar tu candidatura, incluye un portfolio con ejemplos de performance creative. Siempre que sea posible, añade no solo las piezas y el copy, sino también el contexto del test, el objetivo y los resultados (CTR, CPA, CVR u otras métricas relevantes).

Nos interesa entender qué problema intentabas resolver, cuál era tu hipótesis creativa, cómo llegaste al concepto, qué ejecutaste y qué aprendiste. Las candidaturas sin portfolio no serán consideradas.

title: AI Creative Strategist
description:
Impact Clients is building a new organic growth channel around highly targeted social media pages in the supplement space, each with its own character, audience, voice, and content strategy.

The goal is simple: create genuinely useful content that earns attention organically, builds trust with specific demographics, and ultimately drives supplement sales through relevant affiliate offers.

As our **AI Creative Strategist**, you’ll own the thinking behind the content: developing new characters and avatars, finding angles that resonate with different audiences, writing hooks and scripts, analyzing what performs, and building a repeatable creative system that can scale across dozens of pages.

This isn’t only a content role.

What we learn from building this division will eventually become part of the curriculum taught inside our education company. You’ll help train our coaches and students on what’s working while also giving direct product feedback to our engineering team on the AI creative tools you use every day.

You’ll be helping build the playbook from zero.

**ABOUT IMPACT CLIENTS**

Impact Clients is a fast-growing tech-enabled education company helping everyday people build online businesses through a combination of education, coaching, community, and proprietary software.

Our culture is built around **clarity, extreme ownership, high standards, and speed of execution**.

We move quickly. We expect people to solve problems without constant direction. And we give talented people a significant amount of ownership when they demonstrate they can produce results.

If you thrive in environments where creativity and speed go hand-in-hand, where your work gets implemented immediately, and where you're expected to think like an owner rather than an employee, you'll fit in well here.

***This is a fully remote, full-time role.***

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

* **A blank canvas.** Start from zero and shape the avatars, angles, accounts, and content strategy from the ground up.
* **A path to leadership.** Help build the team as the channel grows, with the opportunity to eventually lead the creative division.
* **A team around you.** Work alongside AI video editors and publishing support so your time stays focused on strategy, copy, and creative direction.
* **Freedom to test.** No ad spend approvals or endless creative bottlenecks. Put ideas into the market, learn what works, and iterate quickly.
* **Simple production.** Let the strength of the idea carry the content without the heavy production requirements often associated with paid creative.
* **Exposure across three business units.** Help build a new supplement division, shape how the playbook is taught inside our education business, and influence the roadmap of our proprietary software.
* **Real influence beyond your own function.** What you discover can become curriculum taught to thousands of students, while your daily use of AI tools helps determine what our engineering team builds next.

**WHAT YOU’RE GETTING INTO - The Day To Day of this Role:**

* Creating the AI avatars: determine which demographics deserve their own character, what those characters should represent, and which concepts should be killed.
* Generate **10–20 new ideas, hooks, and angles every day** for short form 7-30 second reels.
* Write and direct scripts for **30–60 second organic Reels**, then hand them to the AI video editing team for production.
* Own what gets tested across **5–10+ Instagram and Facebook accounts**, each with its own personality, demographic, and content strategy.
* Match message to demographic precisely. A 45-year-old man and a 68-year-old woman should not receive the same hook, framing, or script.
* Turn genuinely useful information into content that earns trust first, allowing the offer in the bio to convert second.
* Study account-level performance and identify which avatars, hooks, formats, and topics are receiving organic distribution.
* Retire weak avatars and scale the characters and concepts that show traction.
* Turn winning creative patterns into repeatable systems rather than one-off successes.
* Help build the department once the model is proven, including future strategists, editors, and publishing support.

Approximately 10–20% of your time:

* Once the model is proven, help build course content for the company's education division
* Run a weekly group coaching call helping students apply what we've learned.
* Give our software engineering team hands-on feedback about how to improve the internal AI tools you use every day.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You come from the **direct-response Meta advertising world**, ideally within supplements, health, wellness, or another performance-driven ecommerce category.
* You have produced paid creative at meaningful volume — ideally **hundreds or thousands of assets per month**.
* You are a strong direct-response copywriter, and developing hooks, angles, and concepts is one of your favorite parts of the job.
* You've developed messaging for demographics significantly different from your own.
* You understand that what moves men aged 40–50 may be completely different from what moves women aged 60–70 — and you know how to adjust the creative accordingly.
* You can look at performance data and turn what is working into the next generation of creative ideas.
* You are comfortable testing aggressively, killing losing concepts quickly, and doubling down on winners.
* You are highly fluent with AI creative tools. Our current stack includes **Higgsfield, Google Flow Omni, Openart, and CapCut**.
* You can operate independently without needing a detailed SOP for every decision.
* Ideally, you've also worked on an **info-product, course, or coaching-based offer**, particularly in the make-money-online or start-an-online-business space (optional, though preferred).

The ideal candidate brings an unusual combination: **ecommerce/supplement direct-response experience + strong creative strategy and copywriting + familiarity with info-product or coaching businesses.**

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In Your First 90 Days On Our Team**

**30 Days:**  
Three to five avatars are defined, scripted, and actively in production. A consistent daily idea pipeline exists so the editing team is never waiting on creative direction. The first Reels are live across the initial accounts.

**60 Days:**  
We have a clear understanding of which characters, hooks, topics, and angles Instagram and Facebook are actually distributing. Weak avatars are being retired, winning concepts are being expanded across additional accounts, and each audience is matched to a relevant offer.

**90 Days:**  
A repeatable system exists from avatar brief creative concept script production published Reel performance analysis across 5–10+ accounts, without requiring you to manually touch every step.

You should also be able to clearly tell us what the department needs next, where the bottlenecks are, and who we need to hire to continue scaling it.

If this is role is exciting to you, then apply by filling out the questions below. Truly take your time with putting in quality effort into the Loom video, and our team will be in contact with you to schedule interview within 24-48 hours.

title: Creative Producer

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. This role sits at the intersection of marketing production, creative execution, and performance analytics, ensuring that creatives are produced efficiently, tested systematically, and scaled based on data and results - not subjective taste.

  
Requirements:  
  

Required Experience & Skills:

* Strong understanding of performance marketing and paid acquisition channels
* Conversational English (ability to communicate effectively with international teams)

title: Creative Engineer / AI Creative Technologist
description:

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of generative AI, creative technology, and technical storytelling. You’ll work directly with image and video models, experiment with different models and workflows, push them to their limits, and figure out how to consistently get the best possible creative results from them.

You’ll turn that experimentation into compelling examples, workflows, guides, and social content that show developers and creators what is possible with Runware and help us move quickly around new model releases.

We’re looking for someone who is already deeply immersed in generative media — not simply using AI tools, but understanding how models, prompting, pipelines, conditioning, and automation fit together, and knowing how to combine them to produce standout creative output.

**What you’ll do**

* **Experiment hands-on with new generative image and video models**, understanding their capabilities, limitations, and how to get exceptional results from them.
* **Build and refine advanced generative-media workflows**, combining models, prompting techniques, conditioning, automation, and tools such as ComfyUI.
* **Create standout model examples, workflows, demos, and visual content** that demonstrate what developers and creators can build with Runware.
* **Turn technical experimentation into engaging content** for model launches, social media, guides, workflow breakdowns, and other creator- and developer-facing channels.
* **Develop repeatable and automated generation workflows** that make it possible to produce high-quality creative output efficiently and at scale.
* **Stay close to new model releases and emerging techniques**, rapidly testing them and identifying opportunities for compelling content and examples.

* **3+ years of relevant experience** in generative media, creative technology, creative engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* **Advanced experience with ComfyUI or comparable workflow tooling**, with the ability to build sophisticated, repeatable pipelines combining models, conditioning, prompting, and automation.
* **Coding and API experience**, including building custom integrations, scripts, tools, or ComfyUI nodes.

We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. title: Senior AI Creative Designer
description:

title: Creative Director
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.
  
  
We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.
  
  
Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.
  
  
We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.
  
  
If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.
  
  
****The Role****
Most B2B software looks the same. A few companies have proven it doesn't have to: brands with real taste, that people follow, wear and want to work for.
  
  
Behind every CPG brand you love is a back office nobody sees: the finance lead chasing a deduction at 11pm, the sales team planning a promotion blind, the founder watching margin leak line by line. Confido exists for them. Your job is to tell their story, and ours, so well that people who have never heard the words "trade spend" want to be part of it.
  
  
This is a principal-level role. You'll be our first creative brand hire and the keeper of how Confido looks and feels, setting the creative direction for the company and holding the final call on the craft. A new strategy and identity are underway with our agency partner, and you'll take it from a set of guidelines to a brand with a point of view: one customers share, candidates join for, and competitors quietly copy.
  
  
You'll own every place someone meets us, from the website and launches to decks, ads, events, video and the brand moments inside our product. As the work grows, you'll build and direct a bench of specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication. You'll report to our VP of Marketing and work closely with the founders.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Be the creative voice in the room. Partner with the founders and marketing leadership on how we tell our story and what the brand stands for
* Shape the brand from the ground up. Take the new identity from guidelines to a living system with a voice, a point of view and a standard people notice
* Find the story in the numbers. Turn customer outcomes, like $500K recouped for Feastables or revenue doubled with the same finance team at DUDE Wipes, into campaigns, films and stories people remember
* Make the invisible visible. Put the people, shelves, pallets and trucks of CPG at the centre of how we show up, never just another dashboard screenshot
* Own every surface. confido.com, launches, sales and customer decks, ads, social, email and the brand moments inside our product
* Create moments in the room. Concept and direct our booths, customer dinners and owned events so people leave talking about them. We care deeply about unreasonable hospitality - people should feel that across every experiential surface.
* Build your bench. Hire and direct specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication, with the templates, intake and asset library that let them do their best work
* Make brand and product one. Partner with our product design team so every touchpoint feels like the same company

****What We're Looking For****

* 8+ years in brand design, art direction or creative direction, in-house, at an agency, or both, including time leading brand for a company or major client
* You're a storyteller first. You can take a complex, unglamorous idea and make people feel something about it
* A portfolio with a brand system you built or scaled, and work you're proud to show anyone
* Taste you can defend. You know the difference between good and world class
* Range: you can move from identity and web to a sales deck, a booth and a photo shoot in the same week
* Hands-on craft in Figma. You sweat the kerning and what the work does for the business
* You own work from concept to production, including vendors, printers, fabricators and budgets
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and speed, communicate clearly, and can hold an idea through founder and sales feedback

* Brand experience at a B2B software or fintech company known for its design
* Experience working with or for CPG brands
* Motion design and video editing
* Designing and building websites in a no-code tool
* Experience leading designers or managing freelancers and agencies

title: Creative Director, Fundraising and Mobilization (Evergreen)
description:

Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission.

If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to.

**What to know**
----------------

Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we're delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands' social impact teams.

We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We're looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking.

We're interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

**The company**
---------------

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

**A day in the life**
---------------------

* **Lead and inspire:** Working closely with your colleagues, you'll develop a vision for our client's creative success. You'll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.
* **Create with purpose:** Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality.
* **Accountability:** Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects.

* Generous paid holiday schedule

* Group Income Protection (GIP)
* Group Life Assurance (GLA)
* Optional holiday travel insurance
* Pre-tax season ticket loans
* Cycle to work (up to £2000)
* Remote work flexibility

We approach in-office working with a hybrid model, with presence in our office required at two days per week.

**The team**
------------

You'll be a senior member of the London team bringing in new clients and, as a leader, defining and improving the work we're creating. You will also be a part of our global creative director team who meet regularly for creative inspiration.

**Some things we're looking for**
---------------------------------

* 6+ years in senior creative role, ideally with hands-on designing experience. At least some of this experience working on fundraising and mobilisation campaigns.

* Experience in leading and collaborating with teams of designers, copywriters, strategists and creatives - taking insight that has been shaped and developing compelling, digitally-driven ideas and products.

* Strategy-led: able to clearly articulate design or strategy related dilemmas, and offer multiple solutions with a clear link back to the strategy and insights.

* Comfort and passion for creative testing, co-creation with clients and audiences, and constructively consolidating feedback from global stakeholders to improve the work.

* Impeccable presentation skills: able to explain the reasons behind a particular design or creative strategy, and guide clients through difficult decision points. Experience in pitching a strong advantage.

* Deep knowledge of persuasion strategies & tools: copywriting, social influence, brand advocacy, fundraising, UX and experience design.

* Strong sense of communications and its operating model: how impactful messages are created, journeys constructed and users driven on a journey from awareness to advocacy.

* An area of expertise or passion in the design world (be it fundraising, design, UX, communications or social change) that you can harness and upskill wider team members with as a thought leader within the wider company.

* Industry-leading quality of work: you produce inspiring work that stands out, is flawless in execution, and innovative in thought. You are both a doer and a thinker, and your work reflects that.

* Patient with your colleagues and clients, able to make key decisions when and where required.

* Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you. Teamwork and scrappiness required, alongside respect to our clients and their expertise.

* A shared passion and curiosity for making change. This includes comfort with ambiguity, a restlessness that resists the status quo, and a commitment to quality that ensures we're always making progress.

* A firm grasp on the latest AI tools, the creative and ethical considerations they demand, and a healthy disrelish for written and visual slop.

* Empathy, communication, respect, and the ability to act as a role model at Blue State.

At Blue State, diversity is a necessity, not a nice-to-have. We encourage those from underrepresented communities — women, people of color, LGBTQIA+, immigrants, those with disabilities and people at all the intersections in between — to apply. title: Motion Creative Director
description:
**About Us**

Saffron is a brand consultancy of 100 people with 21 nationalities and 12 languages. From our offices London, Madrid, Tokyo and Vienna, we work as one team integrating identity and interaction to create real value for brands around the world.

**The Role**

You are a creative leader, responsible for shaping the quality and direction of motion across the business. You will lead a cross-office team of 2D and 3D motion designers, working closely with our CCO, Creative Directors, Design Leads, Strategy and Client Services teams.

You will help define how brands move, translating strategy and creative ambition into distinctive motion systems and experiences, while developing the team, partnering with clients and growing motion as a core part of Saffron’s wider offering.

**What you’ll do**

* **Lead the motion and CG practice.** Be the go-to creative leader for motion and CG across Saffron, setting the standard for quality, craft, consistency and innovation.
* **Shape how brands move.** Translate strategic and creative ambition into distinctive motion principles, behaviours and systems, ensuring motion is fully integrated into wider brand, design and digital ecosystems.
* **Direct high-quality creative work.** Oversee projects ranging from motion systems and brand films to CG image libraries and broader moving-image experiences, continually pushing the quality and ambition of the work.
* **Lead and develop the team**. Manage and nurture a multidisciplinary team of 2D and 3D motion designers, setting clear creative direction, supporting their development and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.
* **Partner with clients.** Lead conversations around motion, guiding clients confidently through the creative process and positioning it as a strategic tool that can shape perception, engagement and experience.
* **Collaborate across disciplines.** Work closely with Creative Directors, Design Leads, Strategy, Client Services to ensure motion is considered from the outset and seamlessly integrated into our work.
* **Manage resources and delivery.** Oversee the day-to-day running of the motion team, working with project and client leads to ensure the right resources are in place and work is delivered to the highest standard.
* **Grow the practice.** Shape the motion and CG offering for new business, identify opportunities to expand the role of motion within existing client relationships, and continue developing it as a core part of Saffron’s wider offering.

**About you**

* **A senior motion creative.** You have substantial experience leading high-quality motion work within a branding, design or creative environment, with the creative judgement and credibility to set direction at a senior level.
* **Broadly skilled across motion and CG.** You have a strong understanding of editing, 2D motion and 3D/CG, and know how to bring together the right combination of craft, people and specialist expertise for each project. Experience with live action, in-camera work, generative or procedural graphics would be a plus.
* **Brand-led in your thinking.** You understand motion as more than execution. You can connect brand strategy, narrative and design thinking to define how a brand should move, behave and feel.
* **A confident creative leader.** You know how to raise the ambition of the work while giving teams clarity, direction and space to grow.
* **Client-facing and persuasive.** You are comfortable presenting ideas, defending creative decisions and helping senior clients understand the strategic and creative value of motion.
* **Commercially minded.** You can identify opportunities, contribute to scopes and proposals, and think about how to grow motion as both a creative discipline and an important part of the business.
* **A natural collaborator.** You enjoy working across disciplines, offices and cultures, and know how to bring different perspectives together around a shared creative ambition.

**What we offer**

* A flexible and supportive working environment
* Hybrid working model (minimum of 2 days per week in the office)
* Flexible working hours, with early finishes on Fridays
* 26 days holiday + your birthday off
* 10 remote days per year
* Private health and life insurance
* Annual training budget
* Bonus scheme
* Pet-friendly offices
* A collaborative, curious and high-standard culture

Working alongside our other Creative Directors, you will share responsibility for the Creative Team, blending high-level project oversight with dedicated mentoring and management.
  
  
Day-to-day responsibilities include searching for strategic insights, helping shape conceptual thinking, design and motion direction, client communication, leading meetings, mentoring and 1:1 sessions.

title: Creative Director
description:
As a
**Creative Director,**
you will turn complex business goals into compelling creative ideas. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead client conversations, and create the clarity people need to do their best work. You will also use AI thoughtfully to support research, exploration, and workflow efficiency while keeping strategy, judgment, and final approval human-led.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service company. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Our clients are managing ambitious business goals, changing priorities, and creative needs that span brands, campaigns, digital experiences, motion, and content.

They need more than strong execution. They need a senior creative leader who can find the strategic opportunity, establish a clear direction, assemble the right team, and protect quality from the first conversation through final delivery.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  - Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and project types, including brand platforms, campaigns, visual identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Turn business goals into creative opportunities**
  - Find the human and strategic insight behind the brief. Translate it into focused, emotionally resonant concepts that support the client’s objectives.
* **Guide the right creative team**
  - Help shape and lead multidisciplinary teams based on the needs of the client, brand, and assignment.
* **Conduct Quality Control & Protect the standard**
  - Review concepts and execution for strategic relevance, originality, craft, brand alignment, and production quality.
* **Lead client conversations**
  - Present and defend creative ideas with confidence. Explain the reasoning behind recommendations and guide stakeholders through productive feedback cycles.
* **Develop creative talent**
  - Help creative professionals strengthen their judgment and craft through direct feedback, clear expectations, and thoughtful mentorship.
* **Use AI with intention**
  - Leverage AI tools to strengthen research, ideation, exploration, and workflow efficiency. Retain human ownership of strategy, accuracy, taste, sensitive decisions, and final approval.
* **Build a strong creative environment**
  - Encourage originality, curiosity, respectful challenge, accountability, and collaboration.

**What you will bring**

* Around 8 years of relevant creative experience, including at least 3 years in creative leadership roles
* A portfolio demonstrating strong work across branding, visual communication, digital experiences, motion, or integrated campaigns, with clear examples of how you have leveraged AI in your creative process and outcomes
* Great attention to detail to catch any branding inconsistencies
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams toward original, strategically grounded creative work
* The ability to translate complex business challenges into clear creative strategies and compelling concepts
* A strong understanding of branding, storytelling, design, and audience-centered communication with sound creative judgment and the ability to explain what is working, what needs to change, and why
* A business-minded approach that connects creative decisions to audience and organizational goals with the ability to present ideas clearly, build stakeholder alignment, and guide feedback without losing the strategic intent
* Strong written and verbal English communication for nuanced client conversations, presentations, briefs, and feedback
* The adaptability, judgment, and reliability and strong internet connection needed to work effectively in a remote environment
* Practical experience using AI tools to strengthen creativity or efficiency without compromising quality or human accountability

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection. You will work across client relationships, creative disciplines, and changing priorities.

At least six hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required so you can lead conversations, collaborate with teams, and make timely decisions.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* **Choose Positivity**
  and lift those around you.
* **Say It Straight**
  with honesty and respect.
* **Raise the Bar**
  by never settling for average.
* **Take Ownership**
  of your work and your impact.
* **Move with Purpose**
  and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Creating work that is both strategically sound and creatively outstanding.
* Becoming a trusted creative partner to clients and internal teams.
* Elevating the quality of ideas, execution, and storytelling.
* Helping teams do their best work through clear feedback and mentorship.
* Balancing creativity with reliability, organization, and follow-through.
* Embracing AI as a tool to enhance creativity and efficiency.

**Disclaimer:**

**When applying, please include an updated portfolio that reflects the work you would like us to consider. You may also add relevant project links, supporting work, or AI enabled samples.**

**For collaborative projects, please clearly indicate your contribution and the areas you were responsible for.**

Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.

At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences; it’s what makes our team and our work stronger.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.**
  Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.**
  Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In-person and experiential creative.**
  Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work.**
  Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.**
  Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.**
  Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

**How We'll Measure Success**
Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
$157,505—$218,000 USD
  
  
**The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation**
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
  
  

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:**
  Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
* **Environments for Success:**
  Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

*Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more*

**Please submit a portfolio or reel with your application.**
What You’ll Do

* Lead and develop the Flow Studio content team, setting creative priorities, directing execution, mentoring contributors, and building a team capable of producing exceptional work quickly.

* Build lightweight creative standards, reusable assets, and production practices that help the team maintain a very high bar without slowing down experimentation.

**Qualifications**

* Exceptional portfolio or reel demonstrating outstanding cinematic taste, storytelling, and creative direction.
* Deep, hands-on experience with AI filmmaking and modern generative creative tools, with a strong understanding of the rapidly evolving image, video, performance, animation, and AI production landscape.
* Strong filmmaking instincts across camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, and visual storytelling. Cinematography or directing experience is a major plus.
* Proven ability to originate and create ambitious cinematic work—not only manage or review the work of others.
* Strong understanding of viral, social, and internet-native content, with sharp awareness of emerging social media trends, formats, platforms, and online culture. Demonstrated experience creating or directing work that has earned meaningful organic reach, audience engagement, or cultural traction.
* Experience leading creative teams, giving direct and constructive feedback, and maintaining a consistently high creative bar.
* Comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams and turning emerging technology and complex product capabilities into compelling creative ideas, demonstrations, and experiences.

* The content team becomes a fast, ambitious creative engine that can produce both high-end cinematic work and culturally relevant, internet-native experiments.

title: Creative Director
description:
EverOn Data Center Services is seeking a highly creative, strategic, and execution-oriented Creative Director to lead the development and implementation of the company's visual identity and creative initiatives across all marketing, sales, and corporate communications channels, including video production, podcast development, and multimedia storytelling.

As a key member of the Marketing & Sales team, the Creative Director will be responsible for translating EverOn's business objectives, brand positioning, and marketing strategies into compelling visual and multimedia experiences that strengthen brand recognition, support business development, and communicate the company's expertise in the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

This individual will serve as the organization's internal creative authority, ensuring brand consistency, design excellence, and high-quality execution across digital, print, presentations, proposals, events, video, podcasts, and other customer-facing materials. The Creative Director will also lead the creative development and production of video and podcast content, from concept and production planning through recording, editing, and final delivery.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative vision with strong project management capabilities and a hands-on approach to design, video, audio, and multimedia production. This role requires the ability to balance strategic creative thinking with day-to-day execution in a fast-paced, growing organization.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Creative Direction & Brand Management**

* Lead the creative direction and visual execution of EverOn's brand across internal and external communications.
* Serve as the primary steward of EverOn's visual identity, ensuring consistent application of brand standards across all channels and materials.
* Translate company positioning, business priorities, and marketing objectives into impactful creative concepts and visual communications.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, design systems, templates, and creative standards as the company grows.
* Establish and uphold standards for design quality, visual storytelling, multimedia production, and creative consistency.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen brand differentiation through innovative design and creative execution.
* Collaborate with the Chief Customer Officer to ensure creative initiatives align with overall business, marketing, and commercial strategies.

### **Creative Development & Production**

* Lead and execute the design and production of marketing, sales, and corporate communication materials.
* Develop and oversee creative assets, including:

  + Corporate presentations and executive communications
  + Proposal and RFP design elements
  + Digital and social media graphics
  + Website graphics and digital assets
  + Advertising and promotional material design
  + Event branding, signage, and environmental graphics
  + Case studies, infographics, and thought leadership design
  + Corporate videos, project videos, interviews, and promotional content
  + Podcast episodes, promotional clips, and supporting creative assets
  + Motion graphics, animation, and multimedia content
* Ensure all creative deliverables meet brand standards, quality expectations, and established deadlines.
* Adapt creative assets across multiple platforms, audiences, and formats while maintaining visual consistency.
* Oversee final artwork preparation, production specifications, and coordination with external vendors when necessary.
* Maintain an organized and accessible library of creative assets, templates, photography, video footage, audio recordings, and approved brand materials.

### **Video Production, Podcast Development & Multimedia Storytelling**

* Lead the creative development, production, and post-production of video and podcast content that supports EverOn's marketing, thought leadership, employer branding, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Collaborate with the marketing team, executive leadership, subject matter experts, and agency partners to develop video and podcast concepts aligned with established content strategies and business priorities.
* Plan and coordinate video shoots, podcast recordings, interviews, project footage, and other multimedia production activities.
* Direct or execute filming, audio recording, editing, motion graphics, sound design, and post-production activities.
* Develop and maintain consistent visual and audio branding for EverOn's video and podcast programming.
* Produce multimedia content for corporate communications, social media, website initiatives, recruiting, customer presentations, and industry thought leadership.
* Create short-form video clips, promotional trailers, audiograms, and other supporting assets to extend the reach and value of long-form content.
* Identify emerging multimedia formats, production technologies, and creative approaches that enhance EverOn's storytelling capabilities.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agency Coordination**

* Work collaboratively with the Chief Customer Officer, marketing team, sales organization, executive leadership, and other internal stakeholders.
* Support the marketing team in the execution of campaigns, brand initiatives, corporate events, and digital marketing programs.
* Collaborate with internal content owners to translate approved messaging into visually engaging materials.
* Ensure creative work is aligned across internal teams and external partners while minimizing duplication of effort.

### **Creative Operations & Project Management**

* Manage the creative production process from initial concept through final delivery.
* Establish clear creative briefs, project timelines, production schedules, and approval workflows.
* Prioritize creative requests based on business impact, urgency, available resources, and established marketing priorities.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Identify opportunities to improve creative workflows, standardize processes, and increase production efficiency.
* Maintain visibility into creative project status, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Ensure appropriate version control, file organization, and accessibility of final creative assets, including video and audio content.
* Evaluate and recommend creative tools, technologies, production equipment, and processes that improve quality and productivity.
* Provide guidance and creative feedback to internal contributors while fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment.

### **Qualifications**

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, Multimedia Production, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in graphic design, creative development, brand management, multimedia production, or related creative disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading creative direction and managing complex creative projects.
* Exceptional portfolio showcasing expertise in branding, visual storytelling, presentation design, digital creative, and multimedia production.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and related design and editing applications.
* Demonstrated experience in video production, editing, and post-production workflows.
* Working knowledge of podcast development, audio recording, editing, and production processes.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to create sophisticated executive-level and customer-facing presentations.
* Experience developing and maintaining corporate brand guidelines and design systems.
* Strong understanding of digital, print, video, and audio production processes, file preparation, and creative asset management.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and execute projects with minimal oversight.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to receive and incorporate feedback while maintaining high creative standards.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B marketing, construction, infrastructure, technology, or other technical industries.
* Experience producing corporate videos, executive interviews, project showcases, and thought leadership content.
* Experience developing, producing, or managing branded podcast series.
* Familiarity with video recording equipment, lighting, microphones, and podcast recording setups.
* Experience working collaboratively with external creative, marketing, and production agencies.
* Experience with Canva, Figma, and other collaborative creative platforms.
* Familiarity with marketing automation platforms and digital content management systems.
* Experience supporting a growing or evolving corporate brand.

**About EverOn Data Center Services**
-------------------------------------

EverOn Data Center Services is a mission-critical infrastructure company specializing in the delivery of complex data center construction solutions. Built on nearly two decades of industry experience and a heritage of data center ownership and operations, EverOn brings a unique understanding of the entire facility lifecycle to every project.

Serving hyperscale, enterprise, AI, and data center development customers, EverOn combines specialized technical expertise with a commitment to safety, quality, collaboration, and execution excellence.

Our core values—Excellence, People, Integrity, Collaboration, Accountability, and Fortitude—guide how we work, serve our customers, and build for the future.

title: Creative Director
description:

The Creative Director leads creative strategy, brand identity, and creative operations for High Profile's marketing organization. This role directs creative across every channel, with depth in paid and organic social, and builds AI-enabled systems that let the team scale. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at a strategic altitude while simultaneously able to get hands-on needed, doing the work and setting an example when needed. The Creative Director works with autonomy and brings fully formed recommendations to the VP of Marketing.

**JOB DUTIES:**

Core duties and responsibilities include the following.

**Creative Strategy & Brand Stewardship**

* Accountable for creative direction across every channel and format, including in-store, wholesale support, internal packaged brands, traditional media, paid digital, and organic social. Set the bar and give final creative approval before work goes to the VP of Marketing or other stakeholders.
* Lead creative ideation for tentpole campaigns. Facilitate brainstorms with marketing teams to generate the strongest ideas in the room. Set the creative throughline for each initiative: the core idea, tone, visual direction, and example executions, as inspiration for channel directors to build strategies against.
* Serve as the primary steward of brand identity across all channels once standards are established, holding the internal team and any outside partners or agencies accountable to them.
* Bring an external point of view on creative quality, benchmarking High Profile's output against strong work in retail, CPG, and adjacent categories, and raising the team's overall craft bar.

**Channel Expertise & Growth Channels**

* Define a high quality standard for High Profile's paid advertising creative across digital and traditional media, including display, paid social, video, direct mail, and out-of-home. Produce to that standard across all operating states and their compliance rules.
* Own creative direction and content quality for paid digital and organic social, partnering with the Digital team, which owns channel strategy, targeting, and media spend, to ensure content performs and reflects brand standards.
* Lead creative concepting for campaign and initiative-level work, including seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives, and new channel launches.
* Lead the Design Manager on creative direction for traditional media, maintaining quality and consistency in High Profile's highest-spend traditional channels.

**Creative Operations & Systems**

* Own and rethink High Profile's highest-volume recurring production processes, beginning with the weekly promotional workflow, identifying opportunities to reduce manual production time through AI-assisted tools and improved systems.
* Evaluate and implement AI and workflow tools across the creative team to increase throughput and creative capacity without adding headcount.

**Team Leadership**

* Provide strategic direction, workload prioritization, and professional development to the creative and design team.
* Build a scalable, well-documented creative operating model that teaches frameworks for creative thinking, brief writing, and critique.
* Report on creative team performance, capacity, and initiative progress to the VP of Marketing. Owns creative & design budget and manages to target.
* Builds productive working relationships within marketing and with cross-functional partners: buying & planning, retail, compliance, wholesale, and facilities.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* seedhealth.com • seed.com • luca.bio

You're a creative leader. You can see the tiniest seed of an idea and help a creative team nurture it into existence. Your feedback is considered, clear and actionable. You are a champion of a diverse team, helping them make the best work possible by actively listening, communicating and removing any blockers that emerge along the way. The annual pay range for this full-time position is $180k-$200k + equity + benefits across all US locations (this position is 100% remote-US). Our pay ranges are guided by discipline, level and experience required. Within the range, individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including: your specific location, desired skills/ technical competency, relevant experience and advanced education/ training.

**Benefits + Perks:**

***Health & Wellness***: Choose from multiple medical, dental, and vision plans, with generous employer contributions and coverage options to meet your needs. Enjoy access to top-tier virtual care and a complimentary Aaptiv membership for fitness and mental wellness. We also provide an HSA with employer contributions, along with Fullscript discounts for supplements.

***Mental Health Support***: All employees and eligible dependents receive 12 free therapy sessions per year, plus coaching, meditation, and 24/7 access to Spring Health's digital tools and care navigation.

***Long Term Wealth Planning***: Invest in your future with our 401(k) plan through Betterment, featuring a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of contributions—fully vested from day one.

***Supporting Families***: Our Parental Leave Policy includes 18 weeks of fully paid leave, with the flexibility to phase your return. We also offer four weeks of paid transition time at 80% capacity or four days per week.

***Time to Recharge***: Seed offers 15 vacation days, 7 sick/safe days, 2 personal days, 10 Recharge Days (Summer + Winter), and 15 paid company holidays each year.

***Work Flexibly***: Thrive in a remote-first culture that prioritizes autonomy and clarity. You'll also receive a $750 one-time remote work setup stipend and ongoing access to a $450 quarterly wellness and workplace stipends via JOON.

*Seed is an equal opportunity employer. For us, diversity isn't an HR metric—it is the result of billions of years of evolution; it's our nature. ----------------------

Nen Creative partners with tech startups to launch bold ideas into the world, creating the brands and stories that fuel their growth.

Since 2022, we've partnered with some of the world's top founders and institutions, including Amazon, Andreessen Horowitz, Cursor, Mercor, Listen Labs, Tech Week, Cartesia, and many more.

We're growing quickly and looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company alongside us.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a **Design Director** to lead our brand and design practice.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who can set a high creative bar, lead and develop a multidisciplinary design team, and build strong relationships with clients.

You'll oversee creative quality across brand, web, and launch work from early concepts through final delivery. You'll work closely with our Brand Project Manager to keep projects moving effectively, while serving as the senior creative partner in key client conversations.

You'll also play an important role in new business — helping shape creative approaches, lead pitches and presentations, and show prospective clients what great work with Nen can look like.

We're looking for someone who can take meaningful ownership of the practice: improving the work, developing the team, strengthening how we operate, and helping us build the next chapter of Nen's brand offering.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Creative Leadership:** Own the creative quality of our brand and design work across identity, web, and launch projects. Set the direction, push the work, and make sure everything that leaves the studio meets a high bar.

**Team Leadership:** Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary design team, helping designers grow their craft, thinking, presentation skills, and ability to work independently.

**Client Leadership:** Serve as the senior creative partner on key engagements. Lead important reviews and presentations, build trust with founders and senior stakeholders, and help navigate creative feedback and difficult decisions.

**New Business:** Participate in discovery, shape creative approaches, and lead or support pitches and presentations. Help us communicate Nen's point of view and win the kinds of projects we want to be doing.

**Process & Practice Building:** Work closely with project management and leadership to improve critiques, QA, creative workflows, case studies, and how the brand practice operates as we grow.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **5–8 years of experience** in brand, design, or creative roles, ideally within a strong branding or creative agency environment.
* **Exceptional design judgment and craft.** You know what great looks like, can push work beyond the obvious, and are willing to challenge conventions to create something distinctive.
* **Extremely strong with clients.** You're confident presenting to founders and senior stakeholders, can articulate and defend creative decisions, manage feedback, and build trust quickly.
* **High ownership and reliability.** You do whatever it takes to get important work over the line, stay calm under pressure, and don't need someone chasing you to make things happen. This is not a role for someone looking for a strictly 9–5 mindset.
* **Able to move fluidly between direction and execution.** You can think at the highest level about the idea, strategy, and creative system, but you're also willing to get into the details and help make the work better when needed.
* **Driven to raise the bar.** You want to build better work, better processes, and a better team — not simply maintain what already exists.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Help shape the next stage of a fast-growing independent creative studio.
* Take meaningful ownership over the quality and direction of our brand practice.
* Work directly with ambitious founders and some of the most exciting companies in technology.
* Have real influence over how we work, what we make, and the kind of studio we become.
* Remote-friendly environment.
* Healthcare coverage.
* Paid time off and company holidays.
