title: Head of Content Performance
description:
**We've set the standard in kids entertainment.** 
**Come help us raise it.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.

Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we've earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

**You in? Keep on reading.**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Our Studios create the games and content kids love. This role decides what that content has to achieve, and makes sure it does.

You're the data-driven counterpart to our creative leadership. They own how we make it. You own what we make, what we double down on, what we kill, and what success looks like.

Nobody will ask you to tell us what the data says. You'll be asked to go get the answer, yourself or through our analysts, and turn it into a decision you're accountable for.

* **Run the content portfolio.** Decide which games and content we greenlight, extend, double down on or retire, based on how much they contribute to paid subscriber retention.
* **Set success criteria for new content.** Define the targets a new game has to hit before launch and at every review after: early engagement, repeat play, retention of engaged users. "Shipped" is not a success metric.
* **Own content's contribution to paid retention.** It's your team's primary KPI. You define the leading indicators and defend them.
* **Lead release and live-ops.** Own the weekly release cadence and the content calendar: when we ship, how we package, slice and sequence content, and who sees what, when. Our Content LiveOps Manager reports to you.
* **Keep experiments running.** Build a steady pipeline of tests on launch, packaging and surfacing, with clear rules on what's worth shipping.
* **Shape how the app presents content.** Work with Product and Design on in-app surfaces, discovery and features so the content we make gets found and played. With our Director of Personalization, you define what recommendations need to achieve for content. They own the engine.
* **Tell the content performance story.** Give leadership a clear view of what content is delivering and what we do next.

### **Where the role sits**

* Reports to the VP of Studios. Peer to creative and production leadership in Studios.
* Main internal customer of the Product/Content & Engagement analytics team in Business Performance. Business Performance owns company-level metric definitions and the value-of-content measurement. You build on them, you don't duplicate them.
* Works with Growth on shared in-app surfaces, owning the Studios side.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* You've owned game or content performance as the accountable PM, GM or live-ops lead in a games business. A KPI you delivered, not one you reported.
* You've made greenlight, scale and kill calls based on data, and can walk us through the ones you got wrong.
* Fluent in retention curves, cohorts, engagement and session metrics, renewal. You know what moves them, and you tell signal from noise.
* Hands-on enough to get your own answers (SQL, Amplitude or equivalent), and you know how to brief analysts to get the rest.
* You've run a release cadence, content calendar or live-events pipeline.
* Commercial, not creative. You respect creative work and push it with targets, not taste.
* You've led a small team and built a function from a partial starting point.

**English is a must:** We’re a multicultural team providing a service in **English**, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective **spoken and written communication**, especially in asynchronous and long-form formats, is key to collaborating successfully.

##### **Life at Lingokids**

**Career Growth:** Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to **€2,000 per year** for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

**Remote-Friendly:** Work from where you’re most productive, home or our offices in Madrid, anywhere within a **2-hour difference from Spain (GMT+1)**. The choice is yours!

**Stock Options:** Your contribution matters! You'll receive **stock options**, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

**Home Office Setup:** Create your ideal workspace with a **€400 allowance** for setup and **€35/month** for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

**Meal Allowances:** Get **€60/month** on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

**Flexible Compensation:** Manage your **meal, transport and childcare expenses** easily with **Cobee**, integrating them directly into your payroll.

**Health Insurance**: Access **private health coverage** at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

**Language Lessons:** Learning never stops! Enjoy **free language classes** in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

**Visa Sponsorship:** If you need a **visa to work in the EU**, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

**Company events**: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

### **Passion matters more than perfection**

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

### **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

AI Agent & Tool-Use Engineer (RE2)

**About BSC**

  

The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.
  
  
Look at the BSC experience:
  
BSC-CNS YouTube Channel
  
Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!
  
  
We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured.
  
  
We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.
  
  
If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.

  

**Context And Mission**

  

The Language Modeling Team at the AI Institute hosted at BSC has consolidated experience across several core NLP and AI areas, including massive language model training, fine-tuning, post-training alignment, domain adaptation, AI agent development and unsupervised learning, including low-resource languages. It has been entrusted by the Spanish and Catalan governments with the mission to develop foundational open-source resources and technologies for Spanish, Catalan and other co-official languages. In addition, the team actively participates in various EU-funded international research initiatives. In this context, the AI Institute is looking for talent to help advance its operations, research capabilities and technical infrastructure.
  
The Language Modeling Team is seeking candidates with a strong background in computational linguistics and hands-on experience in Language Technologies; particularly in deep learning, large language model development, instruction tuning, and agentic workflows, as well as related areas of Natural Language and Speech Processing.
  
The successful candidate will work in a highly sophisticated HPC environment, access state-of-the-art computational infrastructure, and collaborate with leading experts both locally and internationally. The researcher will be responsible for designing and implementing innovative techniques for language modeling, evaluation and system adaptation tailored to high-performance computing systems.

  

**Key Duties**

  

* Implement and test agentic workflows including multi-step reasoning and tool-use capabilities under the supervision of the senior architect.
* Develop and refine Function Calling interfaces and connectors using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enhance model interactivity.
* Execute post-training experiments using TRL, FastChat, and NeMo-RL to improve the agentic performance of small and large models.
* Build and maintain evaluation pipelines specifically designed to measure the reliability and safety of model-tool interactions.
* Collaborate with the data team to curate high-quality instruction datasets for task-oriented dialogue and function execution.
  

  

**Requirements**

  

* Education
  + Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or related.
* Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
  + Solid experience in Fine-tuning and Post-training of Large Language Models.
  + Practical experience with Agentic AI patterns such as ReAct or autonomous tool-use.
  + Proficiency in Python and Deep Learning libraries like PyTorch.
  + Hands-on experience with modern post-training frameworks including TRL, FastChat, or NeMo-RL.
  + Excellent level of written and spoken English.
* Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
  + Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and API integration for LLMs.
  + Knowledge of advanced preference alignment methods like DPO, GSPO, or CISPO.
  + Experience in developing benchmarking tools for function calling and reasoning.
  + Fluency in Spanish is highly valued.
  + Knowledge of Spain’s co-official languages is a significant advantage.
* Competences
  + Strong technical execution skills with a focus on reproducibility and clean code.

The role acts as the primary interface between REFS Capital Projects, Design & Construction teams, Digital Workplace, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Service Management, and external construction partners to ensure technology requirements are integrated from project inception through operational handover.
  
This position ensures that technology solutions are delivered on time, on budget, and in compliance with Novartis standards while enabling modern, safe, connected, and compliant workplaces.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Design & Construction Technology Delivery:** Lead technology workstreams for new buildings, office fit-outs, laboratory upgrades, manufacturing support facilities, and major renovation programs; Own end-to-end delivery of IT scope throughout the project lifecycle: Feasibility, Concept Design, Detailed Design, Construction, Commissioning, Go-Live, Hypercare; Coordinate technology requirements with architects, REFS project managers, engineers, and construction teams.

* **Site Readiness & Operational Handover:** Ensure all technology components are fully tested and operational before occupancy; Coordinate transition to support and operations teams; Drive commissioning, acceptance testing, documentation, and handover activities; Oversee hypercare support following occupancy or go-live.

**Company Description**

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage.

We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

 **Job Description**

**QAD** is seeking a **Global Revenue Marketing Manager** to own and execute strategic go-to-market campaigns and drive pipeline generation globally. This role is based in EMEA (Spain/UK preferred) and reports to the Director of Revenue Marketing.

This role sits within the Revenue Marketing team and partners closely with the Director of Revenue Marketing and the broader Revenue Marketing organization to set strategy, run integrated campaigns, and deliver pipeline contributions globally.

title: Lead VFX Artist
description:
**Company Description**

**About Gameloft**

Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games.

There is a game for everyone, and we are now expanding to cross-platform games on PC and consoles, with titles such as Disney Speedstorm and Disney Dreamlight Valley, to provide our players with even more amazing adventures.

With more than 3,000 passionate Gamelofters across the globe, we take great pride in our differences and draw on them to create games just as diverse as we are.

If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game!

 **Job Description**

**WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Main challenge**

We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals.

You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* **VFX Team Leadership:** Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope.
* **Visual Direction & Quality:** Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners.
* **VFX Pipeline:** Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery.
* **Standards & Workflows:** Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements.
* **Team Development:** Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development.

**What success will look like**

After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio.

After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio.

**Who you would be working with**

You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process.

**Your recruitment journey**

* HR Screen Call
* Test
* Second Interview
* Final Interview

**Where this role can take you**

This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities.

 **Qualifications**

**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Demonstrated advanced expertise in real-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio.
* Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real-time VFX in a 3D game engine.
* Strong knowledge of industry-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine.
* Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience.
* Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max.
* Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids.
* Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards.
* Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback.
* Willingness to work with in-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology.
* Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial.
* Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus.
* Some experience with animation would also be a plus.
* Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders.
* You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output.
* You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment.
* You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
* Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

**Benefits:**

* Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year.
* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Flexible work-from-home hybrid model.
* Free language courses.
* Your birthday off!
* 1 month of remote work.
* Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career development opportunities.
* Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
* ...and Thursday after-work beers!

**We can’t wait to find our next great talent!**

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

**Want to know more?** Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**Lead engineering that powers how thousands of finance teams spend**
=====================================================================

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform trusted by thousands of finance teams across Europe. As our **Head of Engineering**, you'll lead a complete engineering group — several Engineering Managers, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers — reporting directly to our CTO. You'll set the technical and organisational direction for your area, build the leadership team that runs it, and be accountable for the economics, reliability, and pace of everything it ships.

You will work with 2 to 4 Engineering Managers, reporting directly to you. You will collaborate with the Head of Product and the Head of Design, and other Head of Engineering responsible for other groups.

Your will be responsible for a multi-disciplinary engineering team of 20-30 people, with different seniority and skillset, spread across Europe.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Technical & organisational strategy**

* Define the multi-quarter technical and organisational strategy for your group, aligned with Spendesk's company strategy.
* Drive architectural decisions and simplification across your domain — clear domain boundaries, “platformisation”, debt reduction.
* Make build vs. buy vs. partner calls, and own your group's AI/tooling strategy: what to standardise, what to pilot, and how you measure impact.
* Own your area's economics — cost-to-serve, infra efficiency, hiring ROI — with a clear quarterly view, and present the commercial rationale behind your investment decisions.

**Delivery & operations**

* Be accountable for delivery and outcomes across your full portfolio of squads, balancing competing priorities without losing sight of quality.
* Establish group-level KPIs, SLOs, and operating rhythms so your teams run well without you in every room.
* Champion end-to-end observability, sensible on-call, and postmortems that actually change things — reducing incident frequency and MTTR over time.
* Sequence hiring and headcount to maximise impact, and defend that plan to stakeholders with data.

**Building your leadership team**

* Hire, develop, and retain a strong, balanced leadership team of EMs, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers.
* Coach your managers through their hardest calls: performance conversations, hiring decisions, prioritisation trade-offs.
* Lead performance calibration for your group and make the final call on promotions and compensation.
* Build succession plans for your key leadership roles, so no single departure puts your group at risk.
* Actively invest in retaining your best people, and keep a genuine pulse on team sentiment.

**Influence beyond your team**

* Represent Engineering in company-wide forums, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and customer-facing teams.
* Communicate your strategy and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives — you're as comfortable defending a roadmap to the leadership team as you are challenging an incident response plan.
* Champion diversity and inclusion in how you hire, develop, and run your organisation.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 8+ years in software engineering with increasing scope, including 3+ years managing managers (Team Leads/EMs).
* A track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder programmes in product-led SaaS on time, on budget, with measurable results. Fintech, payments, or compliance experience is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience operating distributed systems at scale in production, and enough technical depth to earn credibility with ICs and Team Leads, not just manage around them.
* Comfort with our stack (TypeScript, Node, React, AWS…). You don't need to write code daily, but you need to read it and question it.
* Real business acumen: you can talk unit economics, ROI, and trade-offs as fluently as you talk architecture.
* A genuine track record of growing managers into better managers, not just engineers into better engineers.

**Why this role, why now**
==========================

You'll join at a moment where the group you lead has room to simplify, room to invest in AI-augmented engineering, and a leadership team worth building further. You'll have a documented path behind you and ahead of you: Spendesk's Engineering Leadership Growth Journey maps the road from Engineering Manager through Head of Engineering to CTO, so you'll know exactly what's expected of you, and what growing further looks like once you're here.

You'll be based in one of our offices (Paris, London or Barcelona), with a flexible on-site rhythm agreed with your team.

As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.

**About Spendesk**

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk sets the new standard for spending at work. Its single, intelligent solution makes efficient spending easy for employees and gives finance leaders the full visibility and control they need across all company spend, even in multi-entity structures. Trusted by thousands of companies, Spendesk supports over 200,000 users across brands such as Payfit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt and Yousign. With offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain and Germany, Spendesk also puts community at the heart of its mission.
  
  
For more information: www.spendesk.com/press  
  
**About our people & culture**

We believe that people do their best work when they’re given the freedom to thrive and grow. That’s why liberation is at the core of everything we do. We empower Spendeskers to take ownership of their work, to navigate ambiguity, and seize every opportunity. Spendeskers come from all over the world (35+ countries and counting!) but we have plenty in common: we're bold, ever-curious, committed to kindness, and tackle every challenge with a positive mindset.
  
  
**About our benefits**

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth — with benefits to match!

* Flexible on-site and remote policy
* Latest Apple equipment — the tools you need to excel
* Access to Moka.care — for emotional and mental health wellbeing
* Great office snacks — to fuel your day
* A positive team to work with daily!

We also offer location-specific benefits tailored to each market, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships — ensuring you're well supported wherever you're based.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

At Spendesk, we're committed to fostering an environment where all differences are encouraged, supported and celebrated. We're building our culture for everyone, with everyone. Our goal is to attract and build a diverse, equal and inclusive team, where everyone feels welcome and we truly embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

**Take over founder-led operations and build the systems that help us grow.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

You might be a consultant who moved into a startup, a founder’s associate already running important parts of a business, or an operator who has started building software and automations yourself.

You enjoy understanding how a business works, finding what slows it down, and making it work better. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, bring people with you, and build the first solution.

We are looking for someone ready to take that ability further: own our operations function, lead a small team, and join the company’s leadership team.

**About us**
------------

Platform Engineering Masters is the company behind platformengineering.org and PlatformCon. We bring together engineers, technology leaders and vendors through our community, conferences, education and Weave Intelligence.

As the business grows, the systems behind it need to grow too: how we deliver for customers, run events, produce content, understand performance and share information across teams.

Our co-founder, Christoph currently leads operations. You will work closely with him during the handover, then take responsibility for running and developing the function independently. You will report to Luca, our Managing Director.

**The challenge**
-----------------

We have a working business, an existing operations team and plenty already being built. We also have manual handovers, disconnected information and processes that depend too much on particular people.

Your job is to decide what needs attention, understand the business problem behind each request, and lead the work through to a solution people actually use.

Some of the questions you will tackle:

* How do we turn a customer commitment into a reliable delivery process across sales, content and events?
* How do we give teams trustworthy information about what is working and where to focus?
* How do we make recurring work, such as publishing a webinar or delivering a sponsored asset, easy to run consistently?
* Which problems need custom software, which need better use of existing tools, and which simply need a clearer process?
* How do we keep improving our systems without making the business dependent on their original builders?

**What you will own**
---------------------

**The operations roadmap.** Work directly with Sales, Growth, Content and Events to understand their needs. Prioritize by business impact, challenge requests where necessary, and make trade-offs explicit, including when requests come from founders.

**A small, growing team.** You will manage our existing revenue operations and systems engineering specialists from the start, and help recruit and develop additional content/design and growth operations capacity.

**Hands-on delivery.** Prototype, write code, connect systems and build automations yourself when that is the fastest way to make progress. Give your team clear direction and space to own delivery.

**Systems that last.** Make sure critical workflows have clear ownership, useful documentation and sensible standards for reliability, access and maintenance.

**Adoption and results.** Work with business teams until the solution is part of their everyday work. Judge success by better delivery, useful information and time saved.

Your remit is the operational systems supporting the business. Functional leaders own their commercial, editorial and event outcomes; you work with them to make those outcomes easier to achieve.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* **Structured problem-solving and strong communication.** You can understand an internal customer’s needs, question assumptions and explain a recommendation clearly. Consulting or similar client-facing experience would be useful.
* **Evidence that you build.** You have used code, APIs, automation or AI tools to solve real problems. You can walk us through what you built, why you chose that approach and what happened when people used it.
* **Commercial judgment.** You connect operational improvements to revenue, delivery quality, cost or capacity.
* **Ownership in an ambiguous environment.** You can make progress without a complete brief and follow through when implementation gets difficult.
* **Readiness to lead.** You can set priorities, give useful feedback and hold a small team accountable while staying close to the work.
* **Curiosity about technology and the business.** You learn unfamiliar tools and domains quickly and care about the quality of the result.

Experience managing processes in a startup would be valuable. You do not need to have held a Head of Operations title or worked in every area this role touches. We care more about your judgment, learning speed and track record than a particular CRM certification or tool stack.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

In your first months, you will establish clear priorities with the team, take ownership of the most important systems and deliver improvements that business teams can see and use.

Over time, routine work will run with fewer manual interventions, teams will have better information, and the founders will be able to step out of day-to-day operations with confidence.

**Why join**
------------

You will inherit a real team, work directly with leadership and have the mandate to shape an important part of a growing business. This is an opportunity to move from solving individual problems to owning the function that solves them.

**Interested?**
---------------

Send us your CV or profile and a short example of something you improved or built. Tell us what the problem was, what you personally did and what changed. If you have any questions, please contact james@platformengineering.org

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn . Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

### **About the role**

Hostaway is looking for its first Product Analytics leader, someone to own how we choose what to build, and to prove what it delivered. This role is about setting the standards and building the tools that help teams move faster with confidence. You'll define what good looks like, set the standards for how we measure, and bring the whole product organization along with you.

You'll work alongside our product leaders, who decide which bets we make, helping make sure the evidence behind them is solid. In a company leaning hard into AI, you'll also work out what measurement even means when the AI, not the human, is doing the work. It's a rare chance to be first: to shape the processes, metrics and KPIs, in a fast-growing, profitable, AI-first company with low bureaucracy and little hierarchy. Your work will make the impact of everyone around you visible.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, this is a hands-on role where you will write SQL, build analyses, and mentor others rather than purely manage. While Data Engineering oversees the data pipelines, warehouse, and central architecture, you will own the product measurement layer on top, maintaining a dotted-line partnership with the CTO.

**Your Mission**

* Set the product measurement standard: what counts as an active, adopting customer, and how every analysis gets segmented.
* Bring measurement into planning early, so every product requirements document includes sizing, an expected metric impact and a measurement plan.
* Design measurement where clean A/B tests aren't available, and redefine it for an AI-native product where activity metrics no longer tell the full story.
* Bring numbers to investment decisions, and grow metrics fluency so product managers can bring their own numbers to reviews.
* Set the technical standards and build the function: tracking plans, instrumentation specs, data quality, starting with an experienced product analyst.
* Stay close to the work. You'll remain hands-on day to day, writing queries and building analyses yourself rather than only directing others.

* **8+ years in product analytics, ideally in B2B SaaS at a scaling stage.** We're open to strong candidates from other product backgrounds too.
* **Strong data foundations.** You know how to design clean, reliable data models together with Data Engineering, and how to set up event tracking that stays consistent across features and domains. Experience with SQLMesh is a plus. You use AI tools heavily in your own work and understand where they help and where they mislead.
* **Influence beyond your title.** You've disagreed with a senior leader about a number, backed it up with evidence, and your definition was still in use six months later. You've helped a company move from gut feel to data-led decisions, and you work patiently with product managers to find what fits a company of our size.
* **You build the function, not just run it.** You've set up analytics operating models rather than inherited them. You can build business models that hold up to a finance leader's scrutiny, and you can show what actually worked: designing fair comparisons in a complex B2B product and being honest about what a number does and does not prove.

**Nice to have**

* Measuring AI features, automated workflows or API usage; product-led growth; churn modeling; platform businesses with more than one user type (ours are property managers and their guests); travel, hospitality or property technology.

**This role probably isn't for you if...**

* You see analytics as a service desk, waiting for tickets to come in.
* You're a dashboard specialist. Dashboards are an output; the real work is changing how decisions get made.
* You've only worked in large, mature data organizations, where the frameworks and teams were already established.
* You need a formal title to have influence.

### **What we offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.
* **100% Remote:** Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).
* **Equity:** Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.
* **Values-Driven Leadership:** Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.
* **Professional Growth:** Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.
* **Annual Paid Leave:** The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.
* **Geographic Specific Benefits:** As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.
* **Dynamic Team Culture:** As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

title: Head of Platform Engineering, Barcelona
description:
Head of Platform Engineering
  
About Seqera
  
  
Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity s biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence.
  
  
We re a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we re strengthening our internal foundations - and that s where you come in.
  
  
About the role
  
  
We are seeking a leader for our Platform Infrastructure team. This role owns infrastructure at Seqera in both directions: the internal platform our engineers build on, and the infrastructure we ship to customers. A large share of our customers experience Seqera through the infrastructure your team produces, which means much of this work is a product surface held to a products quality bar.
  
  
You will lead a team of DevOps and security engineers, and you will be a key member in our architecture review process, where infrastructure, security, and operability are weighed at design time alongside every other significant technical decision. This is a leadership role for someone who wants to define how a growing engineering organization builds, ships, and operates.
  
  
You will report to the CTO.
  
  
What Youll Do
  
  
Own the reliability, security, and cost-effectiveness of our cloud infrastructure, and the ongoing health of the platform - what gets maintained, upgraded, and retired, not only what gets built.
  
  
Lead the technical launch of our dedicated single-tenant hosting offering: tenancy and isolation model, provisioning, upgrade and patching strategy across many customer instances, operational tooling, and the per-tenant cost model it will be priced against.
  
  
Own our Helm charts and Terraform provider as products - versioned, documented, and tested against supported deployment topologies, with the compatibility obligations that customer-deployed infrastructure carries.
  
  
Own CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and the supported path from empty repo to production, so that teams get pipelines, deployment standards, and observability defaults without assembling them each time.
  
  
**Make cloud cost an engineering discipline:** attribution by team and by tenant, anomaly alerting, an efficiency backlog with quantified savings, and cost as an input at design time rather than a surprise after the fact.
  
  
Lead our security posture in practice - security architecture applied during design review, and the security story we present to enterprise and life-sciences customers.
  
  
**Own our formal incident response:** severity definitions, an incident commander rotation, runbooks for our top failure modes, and blameless postmortems that change something.
  
  
Define what production-ready means at Seqera - tests, observability, documentation, runbooks - and hold the bar consistently across teams.
  
  
Grow and develop the Platform Infrastructure team, including active hiring at the senior engineer level and active mentorship and career planning for the whole team.
  
  
Partner with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to bring infrastructure expertise into decisions early.
  
  
About you
  
  
You have led infrastructure, platform, or SRE teams with direct accountability for production reliability, and you are still close enough to the work to review it, set the standard, and make architectural calls yourself.
  
  
You have deep Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform experience in enterprise settings, and strong opinions about infrastructure-as-code earned from operating it.
  
  
You have shipped infrastructure that customers deploy and run themselves. You know that charts and modules used by people you will never meet is a different discipline from internal IaC - versioning, backward compatibility, upgrade paths, and support all become your problem.
  
  
You have real security depth. You can lead a security architecture conversation rather than coordinate one.
  
  
You treat cloud cost as an engineering responsibility, and you can build cost models that stand up to commercial scrutiny.
  
  
You have built incident response rather than just carried the pager, and you have handled complex incidents including those involving customer infrastructure.
  
  
You are comfortable as a technical peer with senior engineers who will challenge you, and equally comfortable presenting to leadership and customers.
  
  
You write things down. We are moving deliberately from knowledge held by individuals to standards that are explicit, teachable, and enforceable.
  
  
You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you would rather define a platform than operate one that already exists.
  
  
**Nice to have:**  
Experience with single-tenant, dedicated, or customer-isolated deployment models - fleet provisioning, upgrade orchestration across many instances, isolation guarantees.
  
  
Developer productivity or internal developer platform experience.
  
  
Scientific, research, or high-performance computing environments large-scale batch and data-intensive workloads.
  
  
Experience with multiple cloud providers.
  
  
Release engineering experience.
  
  
Open-source community exposure - much of what we build is used in the open.
  
  
Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise life-sciences customers.
  
  
Great benefits
  
  
**Time off:** 23 days for vacations per year, 3 days given by Seqera in December, and the national/public holidays according to your location.

Private life insurance

Subscription to Oliva, Mental Health App
  
  
Learning and development budget per year (1,000 USD)

title: Project Manager (Video Ads)
description:
A freelance project manager to run video ad campaigns for B2B tech clients, from the first brief to the final file.

**About us**
------------

We're Camping, a brand storytelling and video agency in Barcelona. We help B2B tech companies go from 'boring' to heartfelt, through brand work and video.

Have we mentioned we have a 4-day workweek?

**The role**
------------

We have more video ad campaigns coming in than our project team can run, and some of them could start in the next few weeks. So we're looking for one more project manager, as a freelancer.

A campaign for us is usually 6 to 12 ads, and then the cutdowns, resizes and language versions for every platform. More and more often the videos are made fully or partly with AI. You take the campaign from the kickoff call to the last file. You're the client's main contact, you send them scripts and cuts, collect their feedback and turn it into clear next steps for the team.

You'll work with our creative director, strategists, AI creatives, producers and freelance editors and motion designers. You won't be the director or the strategist. You'll be the person who knows where every ad stands and tells us early when something slips. Most of the work is in post-production, the rest is pre-production and shoots.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run several video ad campaigns at the same time, from kickoff to final delivery
* Be the client's day-to-day contact: send scripts, cuts and updates, and run the feedback rounds
* Plan pre-production and shoots with our producers, directors and production partners
* Book and brief freelance editors, motion designers, color and sound, and track every revision round
* Keep Asana, Notion and Frame.io up to date, so anyone on the team can see where a project stands
* Check every ad before it goes to the client: formats, aspect ratios, subtitles, specs for each platform
* Flag changes to timeline, budget or scope to our Head of Production before you promise anything to the client

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3+ years as a project manager, producer or post-production coordinator on ads and campaigns, in an agency or a production company
* You know how post-production works: edit, motion, color, sound and final deliveries
* You've handled campaigns with many versions of the same ad, and you don't lose track of which cut is the latest
* You've been the main contact for clients, and you can say no when a request doesn't fit the plan
* Fluent English and Spanish. Our clients work in English, and a lot of our team and suppliers work in Spanish
* You live in Barcelona. Shoots and part of the team are here

**Nice to have**
----------------

* B2B tech or SaaS clients
* You've worked on AI-generated video and you know tools like Runway or Higgsfield
* Paid social: you know what Meta, LinkedIn and YouTube need from an ad file

**How we'll work together**
---------------------------

This is a freelance role at 2,500 EUR per month (plus VAT), invoiced as a freelancer or a company. We work with you full-time on our 4-day week, Monday to Thursday, with flexible hours and at least two days a week at our office in Poblenou.

We'd like to start as soon as possible.

**Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------

At Camping, diverse teams drive better ideas and better work. We welcome collaborators from all backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful environment for everyone we work with.

* Build capability in key account management and value-based selling

* Lead accurate demand and sales forecasting, pipeline management, and performance analysis across product segments.
* Ensure pricing, promotional execution, and investment decisions maximise profitability and ROI
* Enable robust gross-to-net (GTN) % evolution and customer-focused rebate management programmes, evolving our go-to-market model where required
* Ensure all customer rebates, discounts, and promotional offers are monitored, accurately accrued, and fully accounted for, so that the true net cost of trade investment is understood and controlled.
* Work with Finance to manage customer credit, debtor days, and working capital, ensuring agreed trading terms are adhered to and overdue accounts are actively managed.
  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Marketing, Technical teams, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure seamless execution of commercial plans.
* Partner with technical and marketing teams to strengthen value propositions and enhance customer outcomes.
* Represent the Iberian markets in regional planning forums, providing market insight and commercial recommendations.

Industry Experience

* Strong understanding of veterinary and agricultural channels, including corporate groups, wholesalers, and integrators
* Direct experience of the Spanish and/or Portuguese animal health market, with an established network across veterinary corporate groups, buying groups, and distributors.
* Knowledge of the livestock and equine production-animal sectors, and a working understanding of the Spanish (AEMPS) and Portuguese (DGAV) veterinary medicines regulatory frameworks.

  

Commercial & Leadership Experience

* Experience managing and developing high-performing commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ability to shape and execute commercial strategy at country or regional level.

**About Bimeda**

Bimeda is a leading global innovator, manufacturer and marketer of veterinary pharmaceuticals and animal health products and has over half a century’s experience in providing science-driven solutions to optimize the health, wellbeing and productivity of the world’s animals.

Bimeda’s global innovation program sees six state-of-the art R&D centers across four continents collaborate on an enviable product development pipeline which anticipates the ever-evolving needs of the animal health industry.

Bimeda’s nine manufacturing facilities across seven countries allow the company to manufacture a broad range of preventative, curative and nutritional products including sterile injectables, vaccinations, nutritional boluses, feed additives, tablets, water-soluble powders, pastes and non-sterile liquids.

Globally, the company focuses on the development, manufacture and commercialization of quality Bimeda-branded products while also being the partner of choice for contract manufacturing and R&D services for prominent companies within the animal health industry.

title: Learning Support Assistant
description:
**About the School - The British School of Barcelona (Sitges):**  
The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  
  
BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in three locations, two just outside the city of Barcelona – in Castelldefels, where we have a Primary, Secondary and Pre-University campus, and in the cosmopolitan town of Sitges, where we have another Primary campus. There are two more campuses in Barcelona, located in the heart of the city and featuring a Foundation campus, BSB Esperanza, which offers EY and Year 1 (opened in September 2021), as well as a brand-new main campus, BSB Luca, which offers Primary, Secondary, and Pre-University education and opened in September 2023.
  
  
In September 2026 we opened another campus, initially for EYFS and Primary-aged students, north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area.
  
  
The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of-the art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  
  
Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year-round sunshine.
  
  
The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Learning Support Assistant** to join our fantastic team.
  
  
**About Cognita:**  
Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 20 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are looking for a part-time Learning Support Assistant to join our team at BSB Sitges Campus, working mornings. As a Learning Assistant at BSB, you will form part of the Learning Support Team. You will be required to demonstrate an informed and efficient approach to teaching and learning by adopting relevant strategies to support the work of the teachers and increase achievement of all pupils, including those with special educational needs and disabilities.
  
  
The appointed Learning Assistant will need a proven excellent track-record of:
  

* Demonstrating an understanding of how young children best learn.
* Communicating effectively and sensitively with pupils to adapt to their needs and support their learning.
* Contributing to effective assessment and planning by supporting the monitoring, recording and reporting of pupil performance and progress as appropriate to the level of the role.
* Knowing each individual child and supporting teachers to adapt teaching and learning to meet the specific needs of each pupil.
* Maintaining an interactive and inspiring learning environment.
* Ensuring well-being is at the heart of our provision.
* Having good interpersonal skills and able to work well as part of a team.
* Being committed to on-going professional development.

  
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For:**  
The ideal candidate will support the education and social development of pupils under the direction of the Headteacher, Director of Student Support, Learning Support Lead and class teachers.
  
We require:
  

* English: advanced.
* Qualification in support teaching and/or working with children with special educational needs.
* Minimum 2 years of experience providing support in teaching (desirable)

  
Join a team of enthusiastic individuals who appreciate the rigour of the English curriculum but embrace the freedoms offered by an international setting.
  
A commitment to the wider life of the school, and our enrichment programme, is an expectation of the job.
  
All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.
  
  
**Benefits at Cognita:**  
What we can offer you:
  

* A fantastic team of staff who are committed, supportive and collaborative.
* An opportunity to learn new skills.
* The wider support of BSB including access to high level CPD and future career opportunities.
* The support of the Cognita network including cross-school collaborative learning partnerships.

  
**How to Apply:**  
Complete this application before the closing date. The Closing Date for Applications is: **9am Friday 16th October 2026 (Spanish time).**  
  
Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.
  
  
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.
  
  
Early applications are encouraged, we reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to closing date for the right applicant.

title: Global Head of Operations Excellence
description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

Further supporting our growth and innovation momentum, we are establishing a new Global Capability Center in Barcelona to deploy new capabilities to effectively support its global commercial and functional teams. Located in the upscale Eixample District in the heart of Barcelona, Galderma’s Global Capability Center offers numerous possibilities for professional development such as exposure to global and cross-functional projects and access to global career opportunities.

**Location: Barcelona or London**

  

**Summary**  
  
Galderma is seeking to reinforce its world-class industrial capacities through the implementation of a global end-to-end lean supply and manufacturing program. Within this framework, we are seeing an experienced Global Head of Operations Excellence to develop, set the pace and accelerate our Operations transformational and continuous improvement strategy with sensitivity towards the organizational structure, culture, people and processes.

title: Product Owner, Xsolla Partner Network
description:
**About You**
-------------

We are looking for a **Product Owner** to join the team behind Xsolla Partner Network (XPN). The role is based in the US, and we're open to strong candidates globally. Partner Network connects game publishers with content creators to drive discovery, engagement, and revenue.  
  
XPN is a two-sided marketplace. We help publishers run creator marketing campaigns (xsolla.com/partner-network), and we give creators a way to join those campaigns, along with tools to manage and grow their channels (xsolla.com/for/creators). Each side has its own users and goals, and each shapes the other. Helping both sides succeed together is what makes this role so interesting.  
  
You'll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that's building something new in the creator economy. You'll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life.  
  
This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we'd love to meet you.

### **About Us**

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Research and discovery.** Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next.
* **Coordinate the roadmap.** Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about.
* **Write product requirements.** Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.
* **Manage delivery.** Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.
* **Track what matters.** Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.
* **Keep everyone connected.** Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what's shipping and what it means for our partners.

### **Requirements:**

* **Product experience.** 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team.
* **Customer insight.** You enjoy talking with customers and turning those conversations into insights that shape product decisions. You're comfortable serving more than one type of user and finding solutions that work for everyone involved.
* **Clear writing.** You write product requirements that are easy to follow and help the team get aligned quickly.
* **Engineering partnership.** You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you're comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work in Jira.
* **Cross-team communication.** You enjoy keeping people across the company informed and being a go-to resource for product questions.
* **Adaptability.** You're energized by a fast-moving, globally distributed team and comfortable making progress while the picture is still coming together.
* **Video game marketing.** You understand how games find and grow their audiences, including user acquisition, community building, and influencer campaigns. We prefer candidates with experience in the creator economy or influencer marketing.
* **Creator platform familiarity.** You know how creators work on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, or Kick, including their analytics, audience growth, and monetization tools.

### **Nice-to-Have:**

* **Marketplace or platform experience.** You've worked on two-sided marketplaces or platform products.
* **Partner commercial models.** Experience with revenue-share or performance-based partner programs.
* **Campaign attribution.** Experience with tracking links, conversion attribution, or measuring marketing performance.
* **Data comfort.** You can pull and explore your own data with analytics tools.

Salary range based on US location only. This position is open for global remote. Salary will be determined based on location and experience.

title: Director, Product Management, Marketplace Supply
description:
**Who we are:**

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

**About the role**  
Rover is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead the Provider Product Group inside our Global Provider Organization. In this role, you will own the product strategy and execution of Rover's multi-year provider roadmap: concentrating investment on our most successful providers while engaging our broader community of caregivers to strengthen marketplace depth and develop a high quality pipeline.  
You will lead four product teams working in service to our care providers, improving their experience and how they interact with the marketplace at every stage of their journey. This is a high-impact role that requires a unique blend of strategic vision and detailed-oriented, hands-on execution. You will set multi-year product direction and drive rigorous, experiment-led execution. The role carries direct accountability for supply-side revenue, provider retention, and new-customer booking growth.  
This role reports directly to the Senior Director of Supply based in Barcelona, and partners closely with Data Science, Engineering, Design, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and the International Business Team.  
As a people leader, you will manage a team of product managers based primarily in Barcelona and coordinate with cross-functional teams across Europe and the US.

* *This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.*

### **What you'll own**

Execution is delivered hand-in-hand with cross-functional partners; your job is to define the vision and what good looks like, sequence the bets, hold the alignment, and make sure all investments reinforce each other through excellent execution.

* **Product Strategy and Vision.** Own the multi-year provider product vision: translating Rover's provider strategy into a sequenced product direction and owning the narrative that aligns leadership, product teams, and partners behind it.
* **Roadmap and execution.** Own the product side of the organization's OKRs and the roadmap that delivers them. Ship a steady cadence of well-crafted, experiment-validated launches, landed with quality and followed through after launch until the customer outcome is proven or the outcome is learned.
* **The voice of the provider.** You will be the advocate for what providers actually want and need to grow and run top quality businesses, grounding every roadmap decision in customer research, feedback, and marketplace data, and representing that voice credibly in every executive conversation, including when it's inconvenient.
* **AI adoption.** AI embedded in product features such as assisted tooling, intelligent messaging, personalization and education, as well as fostering AI in how the team works (AI-accelerated discovery, prototyping, execution), while building a culture of AI-native development as the default.
* **Cross-functional leadership.** Hold alignment across Core Product Teams, Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal and Trust & Safety, and across regions, so that product investments reinforce each other globally rather than fragmenting by service, brand or country.
* **A team that sets the bar.** Hire, coach and grow a team of product managers who combine judgment, customer centricity, inspiring craft and speed.

### **Minimum qualifications**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in marketplace, platform, or two-sided business contexts. Experience in the supply-side of the marketplace is a plus.
* 5+ years in people management or leadership roles, including managing senior product managers or leading cross-functional groups.
* Experience driving marketplace monetization — pricing, fee, or take-rate models — including designing, testing, and scaling pricing changes with measurable P&L impact.
* Track record of building retention, engagement, and loyalty strategies for a professional user segment (providers, sellers, hosts, drivers, or merchants).  
  Experience partnering with Data Science and Engineering teams to create and execute on shared roadmaps and metrics, with rigorous experimentation practice (A/B frameworks, holdouts, long-horizon measurement).
* Clear and structured written and verbal communication style, with the ability to influence and partner with senior leaders and diverse teams to drive critical decisions.
* Highly proactive, comfortable operating with minimal guidance in uncertain and ambiguous business environments.
* Analytical rigour, with enthusiasm for modeling and measuring the impact of the initiatives you drive. Comfortable working with advanced analytical and visualization tools, such as Mode and Excel.
* Strong leadership skills and experience giving actionable feedback and coaching, and welcoming the same.
* Comfortable working across Europe (Central Time) and US (Pacific Time) timezones.
* Strong command of the English language (minimum C2 level). English is the official Rover language and is used every day with every stakeholder and communication.  
  Bachelor's degree.

### **Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in online marketplaces with a meaningful supply side (gig economy, services marketplaces, accommodation, mobility, creator platforms, or similar).
* Experience with marketplace integrity problems: disintermediation and off-platform leakage, and incentive design that rewards loyal behavior.
* Experience building customer-centric tooling, business-management software, or 'operating system' products for independent entrepreneurs.
* Demonstrated success leading both 0-to-1 product bets and scaling existing product lines; comfort presenting to C-level and Board audiences.
* Master's degree.

### **Benefits of working at Rover:**

* Competitive compensation
* Permanent contract
* Long-term incentive plan, with a company performance-based cash payout
* Pension Plan
* Meal tickets through Cobee
* 25 days paid time off, plus public holidays
* Private health insurance
* Discounted gym membership
* Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
* Monetary help for adopting a dog plus yearly credit to use on our platform
* Flexible work hours. We trust you to get your work done, and are not watching what times you're coming and going
* Snacks and fresh fruit in our kitchen to keep yourself going
* Regular team activities, including happy hours, game nights, and more

### **Compensation:**

* In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €122,228 - €148,155. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.
* The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential.
