title: Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
description:
Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
=========================================

**Location:** Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

**Clients:** Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

**Reports to:** VP of Solutions

**Salary Range:** $80,000 - $150,000 USD annually, plus bonus/commission based on acquisition and growth of client accounts. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

About McGaw

**Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.**

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission
-------

Own a portfolio of client relationships. Set the strategy, keep accounts healthy and profitable, grow them, win new ones, and get the technical work delivered through the team rather than by doing it yourself.

Why this role exists
--------------------

Accounts need a senior owner accountable for whether they renew and whether they grow. Outside North America that accountability sits in the wrong time zone, so the client's executive sponsor talks to us at the end of their day and the relationship runs a meeting behind.

This is the commercial and strategic owner. It is not the technical builder.

Three problems this role solves:

* Nobody outside North America is accountable for account health, retention, and expansion.
* Executive conversations happen at inconvenient hours, so they happen less often.
* Expansion is reactive. Nobody plans the next six months before the current scope runs out, and nobody runs discovery in European hours.

Responsibilities
----------------

**Relationship ownership**

* Own the relationship at executive level. You are who the client's CMO or VP of Growth calls.
* Run the cadence: biweekly client meetings, monthly roadmap and SOW reviews, quarterly business reviews covering results, maturity, next quarter, and risks.
* Keep the client informed before they have to ask. Never surprise them on budget or timeline.

**Strategy and consulting**

* Find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention. Map every problem to pain, metric, impact, and fix.
* Build and defend the growth roadmap with the client, not at them.
* Do the strategic hands-on work yourself: measurement frameworks, KPI definition, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle program design, experiment roadmaps, readouts.
* Translate technical decisions into business consequences the client can act on.

**Delegation and project leadership**

* Scope the work, then hand it to architects and engineers with enough detail that it gets built right.
* Manage the project, not the build. Sprint cadence, board hygiene, dependencies, risks, critical path.
* Review delivered work against the client's objectives before it ships. You are not the QA engineer, but you are accountable for whether the client got what they were told they would get.
* Know enough to challenge an estimate and spot a bad technical answer. You do not write the code.

**New business**

* Run pre-sales discovery. Qualify hard, and say no when a prospect is not ready.
* Build and present proposals: scope, phasing, investment, and the business case. Presented live, never sent cold.
* Price work so it delivers profitably. A generous estimate at proposal is a delivery problem in month three.
* Work with Sales through qualification, discovery, and close, then take the account into delivery.

**Commercial**

* Own retention and expansion on your portfolio. You are measured on both.
* Every scope change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.
* Run the six-month roadmap cycle so the next engagement is signed before the current one ends.

Skills and experience
---------------------

**Required**

* Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
* Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
* 10+ years in consulting, agency, or professional services. At least 5 owning senior client relationships with a revenue number attached.
* Understand the full marketing lifecycle: demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, and where revenue leaks between the stages.
* Understand how martech drives marketing, from ads to CDPs to marketing engagement platforms, CRM, and analytics.
* Advise on the systems below: which to use, how they fit together, the tradeoffs, and how to get more from what a client already owns. You do not configure them. You do need to be right about them, and to spot a bad technical answer when you are given one.
* Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and how to leverage data to improve marketing returns.
* Track record retaining and expanding accounts, with figures a former manager would confirm.
* Pre-sales experience: discovery, scoping, writing proposals, and presenting them to executive buyers.
* Scope and price technical work profitably.
* Know how European businesses buy, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent.

**Systems.** Advisory command of these. Depth in at least three groups.

* Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
* Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
* Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
* Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
* CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
* Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

**Preferred**

* Accounts across multiple countries or regulatory regimes.
* Work across both European and North American clients.
* Built or seeded a regional practice before.

What you get out of this
------------------------

* You own the full commercial arc of an account, from discovery through renewal and expansion. At a larger firm that is three people's jobs.
* The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You advise on the new pattern while most of the market still sells the old one.
* We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. That includes telling a client when they already have what they need.
* Many industries and stacks in a year instead of one in five, on both sides of the Atlantic.

Observable indicators
---------------------

**Month 2**

* Onboarded onto your accounts, each with a current-state assessment and named client objectives.
* Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
* Every account's decision-maker has met you and knows what you own.

**Month 4**

* Running your accounts independently: meetings, roadmap reviews, budget conversations, scope changes.
* Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
* Zero undocumented scope changes.
* Technical work delegated with specs good enough that it does not come back for rework.
* Running discovery calls and contributing to proposals.

**Month 6**

* 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
* Labor efficiency ratio of 3.0 across your portfolio.
* Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
* Writing and presenting proposals independently.

**Month 9**

* 80% retention of your accounts in recurring contracts over a rolling three months.
* 20% of your retainers expanded over a rolling 90 days.
* Your proposals deliver at or above target labor efficiency. Your estimates hold up.
* Representing McGaw independently in sales and partner meetings.

What this role is not
---------------------

* Not a hands-on build seat although you will get into the tools if you need to.
* Not a prospecting seat. You run discovery, write and present proposals, own retention and expansion, and earn commission on it. You do not cold prospect.
* Not a people management seat at hire. You direct a project team. Managing a team comes later, if the business grows and you have shown you can.

Values
------

* Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
* Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
* Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your account is surprised by what you already knew.
* Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
* Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own the outcome, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits
--------

* Flexible PTO
* Flexible hours
* Work remotely
* Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
* Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
* National holidays off.
* Radically transparent workplace
* Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice
-------------------

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

**Month 1.** Learn our clients, delivery model, and commercial standards. Meet every stakeholder on your accounts. Shadow client meetings, QBRs, and pre-sales calls.

**Months 2 and 3.** Take ownership of your accounts. Run the meetings, rebuild the roadmaps, take over the budget conversations. An experienced account owner stays close.

**Months 4 to 6.** Run your portfolio independently. Hit your labor efficiency target. Start running discovery and writing proposals.

**After 6 months.** You own the commercial arc on your accounts, from first discovery call through renewal. You help define what the next hires look like.

**What is hard.** You are accountable for delivery you did not perform, done mostly by people in another time zone. Managing that gap is most of the job. Pre-sales competes with delivery, and both are urgent. Work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. Expansion targets are real and measured.

title: Senior CRO Strategist
description:
**Company Overview**

**CapsLock** is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across Marketing, IT, Analytics, CRO, and Media Buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a **Senior Marketing Strategist** who thinks like a strategist, creative person and optimizer—someone who understands customer behavior, identifies growth opportunities, and continuously improves marketing performance through experimentation.

You'll be responsible for developing new funnels, conducting market and competitor research, generating hypotheses, managing A/B testing initiatives, and collaborating closely with Creative, Media Buying, Analytics, and IT teams to deliver measurable business results.

Success in this role means constantly asking "How can we improve conversion?" and using data to find the answer.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct market, audience, and competitor research for new and existing clients.
* Develop new landing page concepts and marketing funnels.
* Generate, prioritize, and document CRO hypotheses.
* Plan and manage A/B testing roadmaps across multiple clients.
* Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.
* Collaborate with Copywriters, Designers, Video Producers, IT, and Media Buyers throughout the production process.
* Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
* Identify winning strategies and scale them across similar clients and industries.
* Maintain and expand the company's CRO knowledge base and testing library.
* Research new marketing trends, technologies, and customer acquisition strategies.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
* Present recommendations and optimization plans to internal stakeholders.

**AI & Experimentation Mindset**

You actively use AI to improve research, productivity, and decision-making. Whether it's generating hypotheses, analyzing competitors, organizing knowledge, or accelerating content creation, you view AI as a strategic assistant rather than a replacement for marketing thinking.

We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and continuously improving existing processes.

  
Requirements:  
  

**Essential**

* 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization.
* Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests.
* Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Exceptional communication skills.
* Proficient English language skills.
* Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries.
* Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube.
* Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization.
* Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools.

**﻿****Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

We are building the live-service meta for an upcoming game, and three of its most important systems do not yet have a principal design owner: the events that give the game a weekly heartbeat, the social structures that make progression something players do together rather than alone, and the onboarding that has to teach both. This role owns the first two outright and is the design partner on the third.

This is a design, maintain, and iterate role. Our event event architecture, our LiveOps operating model, and our community structures are about to be defined. You would be the person driving those and designing them, alongside the other Designers, PM and UX team.

This is a fully remote, principal-level individual contributor role on the Meta & Live Service team, reporting to the Design Director, Meta & Live Service.

  

**What we will do together:**

**Events and LiveOps design systems**

* Design events: a growing set of reusable, configurable formats that scale to a meet our audience needs.
* Design events end to end: entry conditions, currencies, consumables, reward pacing, and how events feed and are fed by the wider meta rather than sitting beside it.
* Assist in defining the configuration surfaces and tooling requirements that make running an event a config job rather than an engineering job.
* Help set the standard for how events are specced, instrumented, reviewed and iterated after they run, and retired.

  

**Social and community systems**

* Design various community and social systems that will help curate a strong community that grows together.
* Partner with the various teams to see how each feature can be added to a social layer.
* Design the end-to-end social funnel experience

  

**Onboarding partnership**

* Define nudge, notification and re-entry logic, including the return path for lapsed players.
* Help define the telemetry that tells us whether onboarding taught what it was supposed to teach.

* 8+ years in game design, including 4+ years designing for and operating a live-service title after launch. Post-launch operating experience matters more here than shipping experience.
* Demonstrated ownership of event systems, social systems, or both, on a title you supported live, not only specced.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

* Responsible to coordinate and develop competitive and flexible strategies for potential awards in oncology and oncology-related indications, leveraging expertise, operational capabilities, and technologies to ensure client needs are addressed in the pre-award activities.
* Serves as the lead oncology strategist as assigned for potential awards and/or supports the other oncology-focused operational strategists as appropriate.
* Co-leads bid defense preparations with Business Development for assigned opportunities and participate in other client meetings as needed in collaboration with Business Development, the SVP, SSPC, and other Senior Operational staff.

description:

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

* **Engineering** - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

* **Leadership** - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

**Mandatory:**

* Experience **managing engineers or engineering leads** who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.
* **Strong product sense**: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.
* **Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints**: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.
* You **use AI tools heavily in your own work** and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.
* Deep **JavaScript and React**.
* **Initiative, curiosity, resilience**, and the ability to **give and receive direct critique.**

**Preferred:**

* **Bonus:** Experience with **local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source**.

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

title: Product Manager
description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
* Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.

* Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. *(Examples will be requested).*
* Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
* Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
* Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
* Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
* Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

* Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
* Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

**﻿Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Paid Time Off**

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

**Ongoing Learning**

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

**Home Office**

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

**Physical Well-Being**

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

**Unlimited Sick Days**

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

**Medical Coverage**

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

**Co-Working Space**

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

description:
Senior Solutions Architect, EMEA

**Location:** Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

About McGaw

**Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.**

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. Mission
-------

Own technical delivery across your accounts. Design the stack, build the hard parts, direct the technical team, and keep projects on schedule and profitable.

Why this role exists
--------------------

Our clients are spread across North America and Europe, but our technical bench is not. European accounts wait a day for answers and North American accounts compete for the same people. This role adds senior technical capacity in a time zone that covers both.

  

Responsibilities
----------------

**Architecture and design**

* Design end-to-end customer data stacks: CDP, analytics, marketing automation, CRM, warehouse, pipelines, tag management, testing.
* Lead taxonomy design. Define events, properties, and naming before implementation, not after.
* Solve identity resolution across web, app, offline, and CRM.
* Write ecosystem docs that show where data moves and what breaks if it stops.

**Hands-on build**

* Build. This is not an advisory seat: you will be in the CDP, the warehouse, GTM, and the code.
* Write and review tracking, server-side integrations, and reverse ETL pipelines.
* Run QA to our two-person standard. Check every property in both the CDP and the destination, with a recorded walkthrough.

**Directing the team**

* Turn client requirements into scoped, sequenced tasks for engineers and contract developers.
* Review their work before it reaches a client. You are the quality gate.
* Unblock people. When a build stalls, you get it moving.

**Keeping delivery on track**

* Run the cadence: two-week sprints, a groomed backlog, and a roadmap with three or more months of planned work.
* Flag budget pacing early. Never surprise a client on budget.
* There are no free scope changes. Every change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.

**New business**

* Write technical specs for new opportunities. What gets built, in what order, and what it depends on.
* Produce level of effort estimates accurate enough that Sales can price without a rebuild.
* Join pre-sales calls when a prospect needs a technical answer in the room.
* Say when a prospect is not ready, and what would make them ready.

Skills and experience
---------------------

**Required**

* Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
* 6+ years designing and integrating marketing and customer data technology. At least 3 in an agency, consultancy, or professional services with multiple clients.
* Understand how CDPs drive marketing, with working knowledge of Segment, Hightouch, or RudderStack. No preference among them. Know one and you can learn the others.
* Proficient in JavaScript and SQL. Comfortable in a shared repo.
* Designed at least three full stacks, not just operated tools someone else picked.
* GDPR and consent handled as part of the build.

**Systems**

Depth in at least three groups, working familiarity with the rest:

* Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
* Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
* Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
* Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
* CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
* Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

**Preferred**

* Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
* Server-side tracking under EU consent rules.
* Work across both European and North American clients.

What you get out of this
------------------------

* Many stacks in a year instead of one stack in five. Different industries, scale, and failure modes.
* The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You build on the new pattern.
* We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. You see how it all fits together, which is where the hard problems are visible.
* Both European and North American markets from one seat.

Observable indicators
---------------------

**Month 2**

* Onboarded to every tool in your accounts' stacks.
* Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
* QA to the two-person standard on 100% of what you ship.

**Month 4**

* Running technical delivery on two or more accounts independently.
* Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
* Zero undocumented scope changes.

**Month 6**

* Labor efficiency ratio of 2.5 or better across your projects.
* 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
* Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
* New business specs and estimates accepted by Sales without rework 80% of the time.

**Month 9**

* Leading technical discovery without US support on the call.
* One expansion opportunity per quarter, surfaced with an estimate attached.

What this role is not
---------------------

* Not account leadership. You will not own the relationship, the renewal, or the P&L.
* Not a sales seat. You write specs and estimates and are paid a bonus on the result. You do not prospect.
* Not people management. You direct technical work. No direct reports at hiring stage.
* Not advisory. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong role.

Values
------

* Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
* Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
* Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your project is surprised by what you already knew.
* Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
* Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own outcomes, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits
--------

* Flexible PTO
* Flexible hours
* Work remotely
* Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
* Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
* Federal holidays off for US citizens, national holidays off for international contractors
* Radically transparent workplace
* Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice
-------------------

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

**Month 1.** Learn our clients, cadence, and tooling. Shadow live accounts. Run QA on other people's work to see our standard from the inside. Start owning tasks on one account.

**Months 2 and 3.** Take technical ownership of your first accounts. Build the roadmaps. Run the sprints. You still have support on client calls.

**Months 4 to 6.** Run delivery independently across accounts. Direct the resources assigned to you. Start writing specs for new business.

**After 6 months.** You are a technical authority across the portfolio. You lead discovery, scope new work, and set the standard new hires learn from.

**What is hard?** Accounts run at the same time and the work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. A portfolio across two continents splits your day in half. You will sometimes be the only person awake when a pipeline breaks.

Brand:
  
Nebius Academy

title: Head of Product
description:

title: Head of Lab Composite Measures Science & Integration
description:
Madrid, Spain | Full time | Home-based | R1573009

  

**Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient & Site Strategy** helps organizations understand how patients feel and function in clinical research and routine care. The team develops and manages the instruments used to capture patient experience, oversees permissions and licensing, and guides the evolution and integration of patient- and site-facing technologies with electronic health records.

  
  

**Patient Science, Instrument Development and Thought Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------------

Patient Science, Instrument R&D and Thought Leadership develops new clinical outcome assessment instruments and expands or enhances existing instruments, with emphasis on priority therapeutic areas and market gaps. Drawing on deep expertise in instrument development, scientific consulting, and delivery, the team supports client engagements in collaboration with Patient and Clinical Technology (PACT), IQVIA Laboratories, digital-measure scientists, imaging-measurement scientists, COA managers and therapeutic-area centers of excellence. The team also advances thought leadership through white papers, peer-reviewed publications, books, posters, and podium presentations, working closely with clients, regulators, patient advocacy organizations, industry experts, and other stakeholders.

  
  

**Position**

Composite and companion measures represent an important advance in measuring what matters to patients. By integrating multiple sources of evidence, they help move health care and clinical research beyond measures of service utilization toward a more complete understanding of meaningful outcomes.

This role leads the strategic, scientific, and regulatory development of laboratory- and genomic-enabled composite and companion measures in partnership with IQVIA Labs and external partners. These solutions are designed for use by biopharmaceutical and medical-device organizations in clinical trials and real-world studies, as well as by health care professionals in routine clinical practice.

The Senior Director ensures that the patient perspective is rigorously measured and incorporated into drug-development strategy, laboratory and genomic research, clinical outcome assessment endpoint strategy, regulatory submissions, and commercialization through the application of behavioral and measurement science.

  
  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Director Composite Measures Science & Integration leads the design, development, validation, and implementation of scientifically rigorous composite and companion measurement solutions in partnership with IQVIA Labs and external partners. The role supports corporate strategy, client requirements, global clinical trials, real-world research, and patient-facing care by integrating clinical outcome assessments, digital measures, laboratory and genomic data, and emerging technologies into meaningful endpoints and scalable service offerings aligned with market needs and the IQVIA solutions portfolio.

  
  

**Strategic and Scientific Leadership**
---------------------------------------

Set the strategy, scientific direction, and operating model for Laboratory & Genomic composite and companion measure development.

Partner with IQVIA Labs scientific team and external partners on scientific evolution and market needs.

Assess the feasibility and value of applying measurement science, laboratory methods, digital technologies, and novel data sources to products and services.

Align measurement research and development priorities with corporate strategy, business objectives, client needs, regulatory expectations, and market dynamics.

Maintain expert knowledge of developments in drug development, clinical outcome assessment, digital health technology, laboratory science, genomics, patient care, and relevant regulatory guidance.

Serve as a recognized internal and external scientific authority and as the primary technical contact for complex, cross-functional contracts and projects.

  
  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Direct the end-to-end development, validation, integration, and delivery of composite measures that combine laboratory, genomic and other clinically relevant data with patient-reported, clinician-reported and digital outcome data.
* Ensure that COA data collection, digital-measure data, laboratory operations, and associated deliverables meet applicable scientific, quality, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead research design and execution, including validation protocols, analytical methods, technical reports, troubleshooting strategies, and short- and long-term project goals.
* Oversee the evaluation and validation of relevant laboratory measurement instruments and methods, including installation, operational, and performance qualification documentation, as appropriate in collaboration with IQVIA Labs and external partners.
* Ensure the high-quality, timely delivery of clinical research and health care solutions while maintaining exceptional standards of client service.
* Use performance indicators, process analysis and AI to improve efficiency, scalability, cost control, resource utilization, and readiness for growth.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives and collaborate with therapeutic-area experts, consulting teams, regulators, clients, patient advocacy organizations, industry thought leaders, technology partners, and other stakeholders.

**Innovation, Publications, and Partnerships**
----------------------------------------------

* Translate scientific and technological advances into differentiated service offerings for clinical research and patient-facing care.
* Advance scientific literature and industry dialogue through peer-reviewed manuscripts, abstracts, posters, podium presentations, white papers, books, patent applications, and scientifically accurate marketing materials.
* Lead or support the development of intellectual property, vendor agreements, research collaborations, and strategic partnerships.
* Identify proactive client solutions that create scientific value, strengthen market differentiation, and support sustainable revenue growth.
  

  

**People and Operational Leadership**
-------------------------------------

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team through effective recruitment, onboarding, training, mentorship, performance management, and succession planning.
* Foster a unified culture of collaboration, information sharing, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and manage operating budgets, resource plans, cost-control standards, and capacity strategies.
* Partner with Quality Assurance and operational teams to implement effective quality programs, address performance issues promptly, and maintain current procedures and staff capabilities.
* Manage staff in accordance with organizational policies and applicable regulations, including work planning, assignment, professional development, employee relations, and appropriate human-resources actions.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* At least 15 years of relevant experience, including substantial experience in scientific method development, clinical laboratory or drug-development solutions, and people leadership.
* Comprehensive knowledge of scientific principles, measurement theory, method development, drug development, and relevant state-of-the-art instrumentation and technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries, lead multiple workstreams, manage complex projects, and communicate effectively with clients and senior leaders.
* Strong organizational, interpersonal, analytical, presentation, and client-management capabilities, with the ability to translate scientific insight into practical, scalable, and commercially relevant solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and ensure that they are performed in a quality manner.
* Strong knowledge of the BioPharma drug development industry and applying that knowledge to the improvement of their business unit.
* Effective communication and presentation skills to influence at various levels of the business, including senior leadership.
* Skill in extracting relevant data to measure performance indicators and proactively plan for growth and scalability.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

**Where you'll work**
---------------------

### **Home-based**

You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.

  

**Culture**
-----------

Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

* **Shipped AI to real users** - LLM features or agents in production. You can explain how you measured quality, where you put guardrails, and what broke
* **Builds with it yourself** - agents, tool use or MCP, with your own hands. Show us something you built in the last year
* **Fluent spoken English** - you'll run customer calls

### **Strong plus**

* iGaming — operator or network side
* Data and analytics products

### **Not a fit if**

* Your AI experience is using ChatGPT or Claude for your own tasks
* You've never measured whether an AI output is good
* You've always worked from someone else's roadmap

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Full ownership of the AI product line, reporting to the CEO
* Base salary plus a bonus tied to AI revenue
* Equity - you join before our funding round
* Fully remote, flexible paid vacation
* Company-funded AI conferences and courses
* A defined path to Head of Product - criteria agreed at offer stage

Our **Special Projects department** is looking for an **Architect** to join the team and support the design, production and implementation of LOEWE offices and special projects. This is an exciting opportunity to work across high-profile projects within a leading luxury fashion house, combining architecture, design, creativity and technical expertise.

### **Job responsibilities**

**About your role:**

* Support the Project Manager in the conceptual design and layout development of LOEWE offices and special projects, ensuring proposals are feasible in terms of execution, budget and timing.
* Develop 2D and 3D technical drawings, prototypes, moodboards and presentations to communicate project concepts and solutions effectively.
* Support the production and implementation of projects, ensuring the highest quality standards while monitoring budgets, timelines, materials and deliverables.
* Coordinate with internal teams, architects, suppliers, contractors and other external partners throughout all project phases.
* Follow up on orders, budgets, materials and samples to ensure smooth and timely project execution.
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress, resolve technical issues and ensure compliance with design specifications and safety standards.
* Support office projects across LOEWE locations, including the Paris offices, the new Centro de Excelencia in Getafe, the new Barcelona site and other office adaptations.
* Support special projects such as the LOEWE Showroom and Craft Prize, working closely with teams including Marketing, PR, Events, Retail, Merchandising and the LOEWE Foundation.
* Contribute to technical research and the implementation of innovative solutions related to space optimization, materials, energy efficiency, acoustics and sustainability.
* Research and source new materials, furniture and innovative techniques, keeping up to date with developments in architecture, design, art and fashion.

### **Profile**

**About you:**

* 3–5 years of experience as an architect and/or project manager, with a strong focus on office design and project delivery.
* Experience in ephemeral architecture, museography and/or retail projects will be highly valued.
* Master’s degree in Architecture.
* Excellent project management, organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong technical knowledge and experience coordinating suppliers, contractors and external partners.
* Excellent graphic representation skills, including 2D drawing and 3D modelling.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and 3D software such as SketchUp, 3D Studio or Rhino.
* Strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
* High level of both Spanish and English, spoken and written.
* Strong interest in fashion, art, culture, architecture and design.
* Creative problem-solver with strong analytical and organizational abilities.
* Excellent communication skills and a strong team-oriented approach.
* Creativity, innovation and attention to detail are highly valued. A portfolio will be appreciated.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

description:

======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.

  

Our **Corporate** organization oversees business activities, providing strategic planning, communication, legal, finance and human resources services to the business units. As a member of our corporate organization, you will have a broad view of our company, further supporting your career development.

  

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.

**Job Description:**
====================

**About The Role**

  

The CoE for Mobility & Digital Infrastructure (CoE4M) leads Ferrovial Innovation's work at the intersection of data, technology, and mobility - spanning connected and autonomous transport, digital tolling, mobility platforms, AI-enabled infrastructure, and emerging transport technologies incl. physical and embodied AI. It also provides specific support to Cintra, Ferrovial’s concession division providing Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) and tolling technical support.

  

This is a mid-level role requiring equal emphasis on self-led technical and analytical delivery and collaborative facilitation across teams, business units, and external partners. The role covers both mobility innovation development and ITS/tolling technical support. Programming and AI-augmented working is the default method, not an afterthought.

  

This position will report to the ITS Lead or directly to the Head of CoE. From time-to-time, as needed, the role may be assigned to specific projects that require a more complex matrix management structure.

The working place is as per above, but the role may require travelling during short periods of time to other places nationally or internationally. There might also be opportunity/requirement for 2 – 6 month long secondments in other territories, including the US.

**Business Unit Partnership**

* Partner with BU teams to identify innovation opportunities, co-develop initiatives, and support operational adoption.

* Represent CoE4M in workshops, project briefings, and stakeholder outreach, translating BU needs into requirements.

* Coordinate with wider Ferrovial Innovation team to align initiatives and cross-pollinate findings across business lines.

* Build business cases (revenue, cost, and risk models) to support scoping and prioritization decisions.

* Scope and coordinate resources (internal & external) where a prototype/initiative requires additional capability.

description:
**Location:** Madrid, M, ES

Are you a qualified or nearly qualified Property & Casualty Actuary looking to leverage your technical expertise in a role with broad organisational impact? Join our Group Internal Audit team in Madrid, where you'll help protect Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability through independent risk assessment and insightful recommendations. This role offers exceptional visibility across the business and a genuine opportunity to influence topics of organisational significance.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Auditor specialising in Property & Casualty actuarial topics, you'll be at the heart of Swiss Re's risk assurance function — leading audits across the (re)insurance value chain with a focus on reserving, pricing, and risk management. You'll evaluate control effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and engage with senior stakeholders to drive meaningful improvements. This is a role where your actuarial expertise meets strategic impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead and deliver** a portfolio of audits across the Property & Casualty (re)insurance value chain, owning engagements end-to-end and ensuring timely, high-quality, risk-focused outcomes.
* **Evaluate the effectiveness** of governance, controls, and risk management practices across actuarial topics, including reserving and pricing.
* **Identify and assess** key and emerging risks within the P&C actuarial domain, keeping Swiss Re ahead of the curve.
* **Engage and challenge** senior stakeholders, fostering transparent and constructive discussions that support effective risk management and sound decision-making.
* **Coach and support** team members, sharing your expertise and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing audit team.

Group Internal Audit (GIA) provides independent and objective assurance to support the Board of Directors and Group Executive Committee in protecting Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability. GIA's vision is to advance Swiss Re's resilience by delivering risk-responsive assurance and providing innovative insights that strengthen the control environment and support the achievement of business objectives. As part of this team, you'll work alongside talented professionals who are passionate about making a real difference to the organisation.

You're a detail-oriented Property & Casualty (P&C) actuary with strong analytical skills and the confidence to challenge established practices. You're passionate about risk management and eager to contribute to Swiss Re's resilience through independent, objective assessment.
