title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who we are**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

**About the Role**:

Frontiers is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a defined product, platform, or workflow area within our publishing ecosystem. The exact domain — submission, peer review, production, partnerships, AI, or another area — will be confirmed at the offer stage based on where the business need and the candidate's strengths best align. This description sets the bar and shape of the role common to all our Senior PM positions, so that candidates can be assessed once and matched to the right opening.

You will own your product end to end: understanding user and business needs, defining the roadmap, working with engineering, design and operational stakeholders to ship it, and being accountable for the outcomes it produces. You will operate within Frontiers' one-platform strategy — favouring shared, scalable workflows over bespoke, one-off solutions — regardless of which domain you land in.

You will not wait for a perfect brief. You will spot the problem, make a call with the data you have, and go find the rest. We want someone who treats a blocker as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to pause.

Key Responsibilities

* Roadmap ownership: Define and drive the roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, business priorities, and platform constraints into a clear, sequenced plan.
* Requirements discipline: Gather, document, and reconcile requirements from multiple stakeholders — internal teams, partners, or end users — into a coherent, scalable product definition rather than a pile of one-off requests.
* Cross-team delivery: Work with and through engineering, design, and other product teams to ship your roadmap, tracking dependencies and resolving conflicts without necessarily having direct authority over every team involved.
* User- and stakeholder-facing discovery: Engage directly with the people who use or depend on your product — authors, editors, reviewers, partners, or internal teams — to uncover real underlying needs and validate that proposed solutions solve them.
* Creative, pragmatic solutioning: Where requirements conflict with simplicity or scale, propose solutions — configuration over customisation, shared workflows over bespoke branches — that satisfy the intent without fragmenting the platform.
* Evidence-led decisions: Steer your roadmap with data: define the metrics that matter for your area, track them, and show what you measured, what you changed, and what moved. Be ready to change course when the data says you were wrong.
* Quality and risk ownership: Hold the bar for whatever your product area delivers, and manage risk transparently when timelines, dependencies, or stakeholder expectations are under pressure. Define acceptance criteria, test with real users before release, and own post-launch quality.
* Product vision: Set a clear vision for your product area and connect it to Frontiers' one-platform strategy, so every roadmap choice traces back to a purpose.
* Business outcome ownership: Build and defend the business case for your product. Set the investment, expected return and payback, and answer for whether it was worth it.
* Team leadership: Lead your squad of engineers, designers and analysts toward shared goals. Coach, set direction and raise the bar, even without formal reporting lines.
* Managing up: Give the Head of Product and senior leadership regular, candid updates on progress, risks and trade-offs. Bring a recommendation with each decision you need.
* AI and automation: Find where AI agents and automation can remove manual work or improve outcomes in your area. Then scope, ship and measure them.
* Launch and adoption: Take your product from idea through launch to adoption. Plan rollout, train users, then track usage and iterate until the outcome moves.
* Resourceful problem-solving: When data, access or alignment is missing, say what you need, from whom and how you will get it. Keep moving in the meantime.

  
**Requirements**  

* Clarity of thought: You think critically and bring structure and clear rationale to ambiguous, cross-domain problems.
* Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, ideally including ownership of a multi-stakeholder, operations-heavy, or platform-level product.
* Requirements practitioner: Proven ability to gather, document, and unify requirements from multiple demanding stakeholders into a coherent product definition.
* Technical literacy: Comfortable discussing workflows, data, and system design with engineers, and reading the evidence behind a problem, without needing to be a domain specialist on day one.
* User-centric design: A track record of turning a complex process into an experience that different types of users can complete with confidence.
* Cross-team influence: Experience delivering through other teams and aligning multiple roadmaps toward a shared outcome, including without direct authority over every team involved.
* Outcomes: You can point to what you measured, what you changed, and what moved as a result of your product work.
* Ownership and agency: You take responsibility without being asked. When you hit an obstacle, you ask "how do I get this done?" and propose a path. You treat mistakes as information and move on quickly.
* Domain exposure: Background in academic publishing, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant B2B products, or AI/ML products is a plus, but strong learning agility can substitute for direct domain experience.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
* Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

*Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.*

title: X-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher
description:
**X-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher**
=====================================

Reference

2026-IMPRESS-1

Deadline

15/11/2026

Division

Experiments

#### **Institution**

ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges.

Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage.

Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. One of the goals of our gender equality plan is to reach parity within the Consortium’s different divisions and offices, and several actions have been taken to encourage applications from women mostly in scientific, engineer and technical job positions.

Located close to Barcelona in a natural park and well connected by car and public transportation, with excellent connectivity to the world and an employer who understands the importance of life-work balance.

Facing an upgrade to ALBA II, a 4th generation facility, which will increase dramatically brightness and coherent flux, ALBA is in a phase of growth and dynamics. Being a part of the ALBA team will promote your career and will give you the opportunities to explore new territories.

For more information, you can take a look on our history watching this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gHMqiH4qBAo

#### **Tasks**

This postdoctoral position is dedicated to scientific and technical methods for correlative operando X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) and (Scanning) Transmission Electron Microscopy (S)TEM within the frame of the IMPRESS project (Interoperable electron Microscopy Platform for advanced RESearch and Services), funded by HORIZON-INFRA-2022-TECH-01-01.

The IMPRESS project aims to develop an interoperable platform based on a modular and standardized cartridge concept. The cartridges are designed to be inserted into TEM specimen and aperture holders, as well as other instruments for preparation and characterization, including surface science tools, transport measurements, microfocus X-ray tomography instruments, and synchrotrons. Within IMPRESS, ALBA is involved in the development of a MEMS-based micro-reactor for correlative photocatalytic experiments in TEM and synchrotron beamlines for CO2 reduction reaction and generation of high value products.

The selected person will report to the Interdisciplinary and Multimodal Section Head and will work in close synergy with the Interface X-ray/TEM and Methodology groups, with beamline scientists, the Joint Electron Microscopy Center at ALBA (JEMCA), and with the project partners. The role emphasis is on the testing of the microreactor prototypes in the (S)TEM and x-ray beamlines.

Specifically, the responsibilities will include:

• Executing the commissioning, operation and maintenance of micro-cell reactor systems for catalysis research.

* Contributing to define procedures for operando and in-situ correlative (S)TEM/X-ray analysis services within a network of experts and under consideration of the international community.

* Contributing to the improvement of the micro-cell reactor system and the development of a true multi-technique approach that will benefit staff, collaborators, and external users.

* Supporting staff and collaborators in (S)TEM and x-ray experiments making use of the micro-cell reactor systems.

* Analysing and interpreting multimodal experimental data.

* Disseminating results through peer-reviewed publications, conference contributions, project deliverables and reports.

#### **Requirements**

The requirements for participation must be met on the date of the deadline for the submission of applications and will be accredited by means of the CV attached to it, without prejudice to the power of the selection body to require the contribution of the originals of the certifications accrediting the qualifications, training and work experience invoked in the CV.

Applications that do not present the aforementioned or required documentation during the selection procedure will not be accepted.

Candidates must hold a PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Physics, or equivalent, and have hands-on experience in (S)TEM and/or synchrotron X-ray techniques.

Everyone who meets the requirements will be admitted for the selection process. This position is reserved for those candidates having the legal status of person with disabilities, with a degree of disability equal or greater than 33%. In case of one or more admitted applicants with this status of disability, these candidates will be evaluated at first. In the event that no candidate with the status of disability is finally selected for the position, the selection process shall continue and the rest of the applicants will be evaluated.

#### **Selection Process Development**

The selection will be carried out through the competition-opposition system.

As a first phase, an analysis of the curriculum will be carried out (assessment of previous experience and / or scientific history, degree, training and other professional information relevant to the position). Career breaks or variations in the chronological order of CVs will be regarded as an evolution of a career, and consequently, as a contribution to the professional development.

The assessment of the CV in the competition phase will be scored up to 40 points, which will consider the following aspects:

* Hands-on experience with in situ (S)TEM - up to 10 points.
* Hands-on experience with in situ synchrotron experiments - up to 10 points.
* Experience in developing and testing scientific instrumentation (reaction cells, gas delivery systems, illumination systems, strain cells...) – up to 10 pts.
* Scientific experience in x-ray/(S)TEM correlative experiments – up to 5 pts.
* Hands-on experience with advanced (S)TEM) techniques (e.g.: 4D-STEM, EDX/EELS, e-tomography, e-ptychography, …) and/or advanced correlative data analysis – up to 5 pts.

The best rated candidates, at least two if possible, will be invited to an interview where the technical competence, knowledge, skills and professional experience linked to the position will be assessed, with a total score of 60 points. A minimum of 30 points must be obtained out of a total of 60 points to be eligible.

Provided they meet the minimum requirements and have ranked among the top five after the assessment of the CV phase, at least one person from the underrepresented gender in the division/office will be interviewed.

The interview will include at least:

* Presentation of professional experience and capability to independently design and execute advanced scientific experiments - up to 20 points.
* Soft skills, capability to work in a team - up to 10 points.
* Capability to develop innovative methodologies - up to 10 points.
* Communication and coordination skills - up to 10 points.
* Vision of the job position and motivation for applying - up to 10 points.

The merits will be accredited by means of the CV attached to the application. The selection board may require accreditation by additional documentation, originals or certified copies confirming the experience invoked in the CV.

In case of a tied final score, the position will be awarded to the person who belongs to the most underrepresented gender in the corresponding Division and subsidiarily to the overall company.

If necessary, alternates of the members of the selection board will be appointed by the president of the selection process, and the change will be published in the announcement.

The resolution of the selection procedure will be carried out within a maximum period of six months from the deadline for submitting applications for participation.

The selection process may be declared vacant if the selection board considers not to have found eligible candidates for the position although they might meet the requirements to participate in the selection process specified in the offer.

#### **Other information**

Temporary contract linked to the HORIZON-INFRA-2022-TECH-01-01 IMPRESS project.

Base salary range €39,350 – €42,982 gross per year.

The base salary offered will be determined according to the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant professional experience, competencies and overall suitability for the position.

ALBA also offers an attractive employment conditions, including flexible working arrangements and professional development opportunities.

The Selection Board is composed by the following members: Núria Bagués Salguero, Antoni García de Herreros Dunyac, Joaquín Otón Pérez, Lucía Aballe Aramburu.

title: Head of Marketing, B2B Payments
description:
**About Rebill**
Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.
  
  
The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.
  
  
Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.
  
  
Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.
  
  
Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.
  
  
Built locally. Designed to scale globally.
  
  
Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).
  
  
Why this role exists
  
  
Our product is ahead of our brand.
  
  
We show up in evaluations against the large regional processors. In too many of them we are not in the room at all, and in the ones where we are, we read as earlier stage than we are. A company about to route its regional volume through us needs to see infrastructure, not a startup. That gap costs us deals we should be winning on product.
  
  
At the same time, every piece of marketing we do today is run by the founders in the gaps between other jobs: the ads, the SEO, the content, the launches, the events. It holds at twelve people. It will not hold through the next stage.
  
  
This role owns both.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Brand and positioning. One story about what Rebill is and why it matters, decided once and held everywhere: the site, the deck, the product, the sales calls. There are four versions of it today. The harder half of this is moving Rebill from looking like a startup to being credible to a bank, a public company or a regulated buyer, and doing it without losing the reason people like working with us. Visual identity and the standard of every surface that carries our name are part of the job.
* Product marketing. Our product is technical and our buyer gets more sophisticated every quarter. Someone has to turn what engineering ships into something a CFO or a VP of Finance understands and acts on: launches with a real process behind them, sales material that shortens a cycle instead of decorating it, and airtime for the people building it.
* Content and distribution. Build the publishing engine: site, blog, LinkedIn, press, and the organic surface that AI assistants cite when someone asks how to collect across Latin America. Content goes out in English first and gets localized per market after.
* Events and founder positioning. Own the calendar and the outcome, from Money20/20 and Febraban class shows down to dinners for fifteen people that move one account. Booth, content, capture, follow-up, and the discipline of cross-referencing scanned leads against the CRM so we know what was net new and which opportunities we influenced. The bar is that events pay for themselves and that you can show it. You will also get our founders onto the right stages and make them better once they are up there.
* Demand generation. Campaigns, paid, funnel instrumentation and the loop back to sales. You inherit what the founders run today, starting with Google Ads and SEO.
* Ecosystem. Accelerators, communities, partner co-marketing and the Y Combinator network.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You work inside a technology company today, or did until recently, and someone else paid for that learning curve. Rebill is not where you find out how software gets built and sold. Payments or fintech in Latin America is where our strongest candidates come from. Failing that, a technical B2B category with a sophisticated buyer and a long sales cycle. If your career is in agencies, consulting or consumer brands, this is not the role.
* You have sold to companies, not consumers. You know what a long enterprise cycle feels like from the inside and what actually counts as proof inside one.
* You have run marketing across several countries from one seat. Not one market with regional support. Several markets with different payment cultures, different press and different buyers, with a team you could count on one hand.
* Your career passed through more than one discipline. The people who are best at this job have some combination of classical brand work, where owning a brand meant owning a business, hands-on paid media, and time spent close to product. One lane is not enough here. Two or three is what makes the difference.
* You are hands-on. You write the copy, brief the designer, build the deck and pull the numbers yourself. For the first stretch there is nobody to hand it to.
* You write English at a level that does not need editing, and you present in English and Spanish. Our content is English first.

You use AI tools every day and it is visible in how much you ship and how good it is.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Portuguese. Brazil is a priority market and we invest there.
* You have taken a company through the move from looking like a startup to being credible to a regulated buyer, and you remember what actually shifted it.
* Press and analyst relations in payments or fintech.
* Ownership of a booth or a program at an event the size of Money20/20 or Febraban.
* You have managed a designer or an agency and held visual consistency across markets.
* A real network in the Latin American fintech ecosystem: accelerators, communities, funds, operators.

**What Success Looks Like**
In the first 90 days there is one version of our story and everyone uses it. The site, the deck and the sales team say the same thing, and you can explain in one paragraph why a company should route its regional volume through us.
  
  
By six months there is a content engine publishing in English with a localization path, launches have a process attached to them, and our events are measured against pipeline instead of against how the booth felt.
  
  
By twelve months, when a mid-market or enterprise company in the Americas starts looking for a way to collect across the region, we are on the shortlist. Marketing sources a measurable share of new pipeline and you know which share and why.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**
There is no team to inherit. You are the marketing function for the first stretch, and you hire in the second year, not the first.
  
  
The founders stay the public faces of Rebill. We want you to make us better at that and to build a brand that outlasts us doing it. We are not looking for someone to be the voice instead of us.
  
  
We keep marketing in-house. We use agencies for specific pieces, press and visual identity among them, and we do not hand anyone the brand.
  
  
You report to the co-founders, and you will spend your first months earning credibility with people who have never worked alongside a marketing function. That is part of the job and not a sign that it is going badly.
  
  
**Compensation**
Competitive base, meaningful equity, and the scope of a founding function. Hybrid in Buenos Aires, Bogotá or Miami. Remote from Mexico City or São Paulo, with regular time in one of our offices. Travel for events and offsites.

* Develop blended learning journeys that combine live and digital experiences.

Drive Bain Academy’s growth and strategy
  

* Partner with senior leadership to refine and implement Bain Academy’s global strategy.
* Develop marketing materials and build internal awareness and demand for Bain Academy offerings.

You bring consulting experience, a passion for learning design and delivery, and the confidence to step seamlessly into client-facing situations as both a subject matter expert and trusted advisor.

* A demonstrated passion for training, with experience as a trainer at a global program preferred.
* Experience managing teams in project-based environments.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with fluency in written and spoken English.
* A creative, detail-oriented, execution-focused approach and the ability to adapt to evolving needs.
* The ability to work independently and take initiative with limited direction.
* The ability to work effectively across global teams, including flexibility to adjust priorities and working hours to meet client needs.
* Willingness to travel.
* A high level of discretion when managing confidential and sensitive information.
* A personal commitment to lifelong learning.

description:

**Job Number**26124869  
**Job Category**Sales & Marketing  
**Location**Palm West Beach Palm Jumeirah Road, Dubai 0, United Arab Emirates  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers. Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel. This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness. This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons. As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization. This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel. Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

**Required:**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Hotel Marketing and Advertising**

* Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.

* Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.

* Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns' creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.

* Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.

* Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups

* Executes email marketing, and display advertising.

* Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.

* Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.

**Social Media Content Management**

* Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (e.g., hotel website, travel sites).

* Develops and executes promotions campaign in F&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.

* Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.

**Public Relations and Visual Asset Management**

* Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM.

* Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.

* Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.

* Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.

* Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.

* Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy & activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives.

* Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution.

* Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s).

* Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.

* Supports the co-ordination of photography for F&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.

* Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.

* Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice.

**Direct Marketing and Collateral Development**

* Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials.

* Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.

* Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.

* Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.

* Manages the execution of F&B direct marketing activities.

* Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).

**General**

* Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F&B promotions and campaigns.

* Helps with the publication of hotel’s newsletter(s).

* Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.

* Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F&B promotions.

* Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel’s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.

* Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy.

* Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.

* Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance.

* Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. Always." by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that's synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you're happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand's namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you'll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That's The JW Treatment. title: Head of Video
description:
**We're hiring: Head of Video – Ramos Real Estate Dubai**

Lead the visual identity of a growing real estate and property tech group.

For four years, Ramos Real Estate has helped clients invest in Dubai property, with a strong focus on off-plan projects and international buyers, especially from Nigeria. We're growing fast alongside our sister company, Expert Listing, a property platform built for Nigeria.

We're looking for a talented video editor and shooter to own our content from idea to final cut. This isn't a "shoot what you're told" role. You'll shape how our brand looks, sounds and feels across every platform.

**What you'll own**

* Our video style and direction across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook
* Shooting property tours, off-plan launches, show units, drone and lifestyle footage across Dubai
* Editing high-quality short-form and long-form videos, including faceless content with voice-overs, motion graphics and captions
* A monthly plan of 20+ finished videos, created with our marketing team
* Tracking what performs and using the data to improve each month's content

**What success looks like**

* 20+ finished videos delivered every month
* Edits turned around within 48 hours of a shoot
* Content that grows our reach, engagement and buyer enquiries month on month

**What we're looking for**

* A strong showreel with real estate, luxury, architecture or lifestyle content
* Advanced editing skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut
* Confidence shooting with mirrorless cameras, gimbals and audio equipment
* A sharp eye for storytelling, pacing and social media trends
* Ability to work independently and deliver on time
* Based in Dubai

**What we offer**

* Salary: AED 5,000–7,000 per month, depending on experience
* Monthly performance bonus for hitting delivery and results targets
* Bonus when a lead from your content turns into a closed sale
* Guaranteed salary review after 3 months
* Creative freedom to define the brand's visual style
* Flexible working: edit remotely between shoots
* Camera, gimbal and audio kit provided
* A clear path to lead content across two growing companies

**How to apply**

Send your CV and portfolio or showreel to info@ramosrealestatedubai.com with the subject line "Head of Video – [Your Name]."

In your email, include a short note describing one real estate video you'd create for us.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test edit, and we aim to make a decision within one week. Applications without a CV, portfolio and video idea won't be considered.

title: Director of Product Design, Engage
description:
**About Ancestry:**

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.
  
  
We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- ). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.
  
  
Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

title: Director of Learning Design
description:
**About Tergar Schools**

Tergar Schools is a Buddhist-inspired K–12 education nonprofit building a new model of learning (MOL). We operate a pilot school in Kathmandu, Nepal, and are constructing a larger campus in the Yolmo Valley in the Himalayas.

Our model rests on a simple starting point: every child possesses basic goodness and its qualities of awareness, love, compassion, wisdom, and joy. It is our job as educators to help them recognize this and give them tools to sustain it. Our long-term aspiration is to help form people who are resilient, altruistic, and joyful.

We’re now building the next chapter of that work: a comprehensive, fully secular model designed to weave into any school’s existing life — not just our own campuses. Rather than build more schools ourselves, we intend to reach 100+ schools in 4+ countries within five years by helping other schools, secular or religious, adopt the model as their own.

**Why This Role Exists**

Our footprint is growing quickly. Two high-performing private schools will begin piloting our model of learning in 2027. A research lab opens in Nepal with a world-class science team. The interest is real and growing.

What we don’t have yet is a full-time position for building the model itself — the products, courses, training materials, and classroom materials that will constitute MOL — and for leading the team that builds it out.

Today that thinking lives mostly with our Executive Director and the instincts of our founding team. This isn’t sustainable at scale. We need someone who can be fully dedicated to this element of our project: an outside-the-box thinker with real contemplative experience, genuinely excited by the challenge of building an entire family of products from scratch rather than adapting an existing portfolio.

**The Opportunity**

This is a builder’s role. You will not inherit a finished product, a proven training program, or a team. You will build those things — starting hands-on, in the room, with our first two outside partner schools — and then lead the team that takes them to scale.

We have materials. However, none of them is a comprehensive, fully secular contemplative model designed to weave into everything a school already does. That is what you would be building, and there is no template for it.

If you are energized by deciding who you need around you rather than inheriting an org chart, and comfortable being personally in the work now so that later you can hand it to people you have trained this is the position for you. .

**What You’ll Own**

**Building the model**

* Design the teacher training program at the center of the MOL — the core product.
* Build out the materials that make the training usable in a real school. Today we imagine adaptable toolkits fitted by hand to each school, a playbook for staff and administrators, and family-facing materials. That is a starting hypothesis, not a spec — the process of choosing what comes is yours to lead.
* Run the model as a product, not a document. Form real hypotheses about what teachers and schools need, test them in live classrooms, and let what you learn change what gets built.
* Propose what gets built now and what waits — and defend those calls. We hold two commitments at once: build lean, and be the best in the world at this. We call it *Minimum Viable Mastery*. You are the person who makes that real week to week, not just in principle.

**Nailing the first schools**

* Be personally hands-on with our new partner schools in Nepal as they begin onboarding in 2027. You will do this work in tandem with the Executive Director (ED).
* Use what you learn there to define what a stable first phase actually looks like, and build the real template other schools will follow.

**Building your team**

* Decide what team you need, and in what order — a Nepal Country Director and Trainer, Country Coordinators, strategic consultants, instructional designers, a UX researcher, and others as the shape of the work becomes clear (a Head of Training in Nepal is currently being hired).
* The ED and the Director of Operations (DOO) authorize and execute the actual hiring. The judgment about who and when is yours.

**Setting the standard, over time**

* Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche and the ED hold final say on model fidelity today. As you build a track record — likely marked by a completed first onboarding cycle with our two partner schools — that authority shifts substantively to you.
* Turn Rinpoche’s two to four multi-day sessions a year into material the team can use again: recorded, distilled, built into training, rather than a remarkable conversation nobody can revisit.

**Working with the evidence**

* Partner with the research lab opening in Nepal in late 2026 — led by Drs. Richard Davidson, Robert Roeser, and Robin Nusslock — translating what they learn into real product and training decisions.

  

**What’s Yours, and What Isn’t**

You own the model and the team you build around you. Three things sit outside that:

* **Fundraising and donor relationships.** A separate role entirely.
* **In-country adaptation and community relationships.** Local teams own this on the ground, but you liaise with them directly and are in very frequent communication.
* **Hiring mechanics.** You decide who you need and when; the DOO handles offers, contracts, and process.

One thing sits in between: **production**. Instructional designers, visual designers, and media support will eventually build finished materials from your direction. You will not be making them yourself for long — but their quality is still on you.

**Who You Are**

**What we’re really looking for**

* **A builder grounded in pedagogy.** Deep pedagogical expertise is essential — you understand how children and adults actually learn, and you've designed for it. What sets you apart is that you build and deliver: you've turned that expertise into programs, curricula, or training that real teachers use. A tech or startup background alongside that is a genuine asset.
* **Fluency in a lean approach to product design.** You can talk concretely about strategic experiments, problem/solution and product/market fit, and validated learning — and you have actually worked that way, not just read about it.
* **Real, lived contemplative experience.** A genuine taste of practice, not necessarily in Tergar’s own lineage, and not merely theoretical familiarity. This is the one non-negotiable that doesn’t bend for the right resume.
* **Comfortable being hands-on first and stepping back later.** Personally in the work with our first schools, then deliberately building the standards and training that let a team carry it without you in the room.
* **Able to build lean and aim to be the best in the world at the same time,** without treating those as a trade-off.

**Experience**

* You bring substantial experience in education — as a teacher, school leader, curriculum developer, or learning designer — and you've built something real from that experience and gotten it into people's hands without much money or staff.
* Some experience directing, mentoring, or building a team from scratch, since you will be doing exactly that here.
* Comfort working directly from a founder’s evolving vision rather than a finished brief — you will be co-writing the brief as you go, especially in the first months.

**Personal qualities**

* Discernment above all: knowing which calls are yours to make outright and which need to go to the Rinpoche or the ED. This carries more weight here than almost any other quality, because for a long stretch there is no layer of management between your judgment and the model’s integrity.
* Genuine curiosity about and respect for a tradition that may not be your own, without needing to adopt it as your own practice.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a mandate that will keep changing shape under you as the first schools teach you things no one currently knows.

  

**How We Work Together**

* Intensive, hands-on time in Nepal during onboarding and the first deployment of the model. Expect three to five months during the first year.
* Frequent, close contact with the ED for the first six months, settling into a slower rhythm as trust builds.
* Two to four multi-day sessions a year with Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche, alongside the wider team.
* A small, distributed, high-autonomy culture across Vermont, Wisconsin, Ireland, Kathmandu, and Minnesota — deep, steady, skillful work over speed.

  

**Compensation & Logistics**

* Full-time
* Fully remote.
* Compensation: $75,000–$100,000, DOE
* Benefits: flexible schedule, unlimited PTO, and health care reimbursement up to $1,000 per month

title: Director, Global Network & Systems Design - NSD
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com .

**Job Description:**

Role Overview

The Director, Global Network & Systems Design (NSD) provides global technical, organizational and strategic leadership for the design, architecture, testing and delivery of network and systems solutions supporting Fluence’s utility-scale energy storage portfolio.

This role leads the Global NSD organization and is accountable for establishing the technical architecture, engineering requirements, global standards, and governance necessary to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and repeatable solutions across Fluence’s global project portfolio. The Director leads a team of senior technical experts, including Principal Engineers and Architects, and provides technical direction across complex IT/OT environments spanning network infrastructure, cybersecurity, SCADA, controls, cloud connectivity, system architecture, testing, and validation.

The Director partners closely with Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Services, Sales, and regional Customer Success teams to translate customer, product, grid, and regional requirements into scalable global solutions.

Global NSD retains technical ownership through from design through commissioning.. Following commissioning, solutions transition to Services for 24x7 operational support, with Global NSD providing advanced technical escalation and leading redesign or architectural changes when required. In addition, Global NSD to support services fleet reliability and optimization process by providing documentation, developing training and supporting Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) development.

* Key Responsibilities

Global Technical Strategy & Leadership

* Lead the Global NSD organization, including Principal Engineers, Architects, and other senior technical resources supporting Fluence’s global project portfolio.

* Establish and execute the long-term NSD technical strategy and roadmap in alignment with Fluence’s product strategy, Customer Success priorities, and business objectives.

* Define clear technical ownership, decision rights, engineering governance, and escalation paths across the NSD lifecycle.

* Build organizational capability and technical depth to support increasing project scale, complexity, and geographic expansion.

* Develop senior technical talent and establish appropriate career pathways, succession planning, and capability development.

* Establish resource and capacity planning practices that align specialized technical expertise with global project demand and business priorities.

Architecture, Standards & Governance

* Own and govern global reference architectures, engineering standards, design principles, and technical requirements across network and IT/OT infrastructure.

* Establish standardized approaches for secure network architecture, cybersecurity, SCADA and controls integration, cloud connectivity, testing, and system validation.

* Ensure global standards appropriately address customer requirements, grid codes, cybersecurity requirements, regulatory obligations, and regional technical standards.

* Drive reuse and standardization while establishing appropriate governance for customer- or project-specific design deviations.

* Establish engineering quality gates and technical design reviews throughout the project lifecycle.

* Ensure architecture and engineering decisions support system reliability, maintainability, cybersecurity, scalability, and long-term serviceability.

Project Delivery & Commissioning

* Provide global technical oversight of NSD solutions from requirements definition and architecture through engineering, delivery, testing, and commissioning.

* Ensure technical requirements and designs are sufficiently defined before execution and appropriately governed throughout delivery.

* Partner with regional project and commissioning organizations to resolve complex technical issues affecting schedule, quality, system performance, or customer acceptance.

* Establish clear technical readiness and acceptance criteria for transition from project commissioning to operational support.

* Ensure effective technical handoff to Services, including required architecture, configuration, documentation, and support information.

* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex network and systems issues requiring architectural decisions, redesign, or specialized engineering intervention.

Service Transition & Lifecycle Support

* Partner with Services to establish an effective process between Global NSD and the global 24x7 support organization.

* Define escalation pathways and technical engagement models for issues requiring Global NSD expertise following operational handoff.

* Lead or oversee network redesign and significant architectural changes arising from operational experience, customer requirements, product evolution, or cybersecurity needs.

* Incorporate field and service experience into continuous improvement of global architectures, standards, engineering practices, and future project designs.

Cross-Functional & Global Partnership

* Partner across Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Services, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Sales, and regional Customer Success organizations.

* Translate regional and customer-specific requirements into scalable global technical solutions while minimizing unnecessary customization.

* Partner with Product and Engineering to identify recurring field requirements and influence product roadmap priorities.

* Communicate complex technical risks, decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to senior technical and business leadership.

* Support critical customer and project engagements where senior technical leadership is required.

* Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

* 12+ years of progressive experience in network engineering, systems architecture, IT/OT infrastructure, industrial controls, power systems, or a related technical field.

* 5+ years of leadership experience managing senior engineers, technical leaders, architects, or globally distributed engineering teams.

* Demonstrated experience leading architecture and engineering for complex, mission-critical industrial, energy, or critical infrastructure environments.

* Strong technical expertise in industrial networking and IT/OT architectures, including network design, segmentation, routing, switching, firewalls, secure remote connectivity, and resilient/high-availability architectures.

* Strong understanding of industrial cybersecurity principles and their application within critical infrastructure environments.

* Experience with SCADA, PLCs, plant controls, industrial communication protocols, and integration of control systems within complex operating environments.

* Demonstrated experience establishing technical standards, reference architectures, engineering governance, and design-review processes across multiple projects or regions.

* Experience leading technical delivery through design, implementation, testing, commissioning, and transition to operations.

* Strong understanding of system verification, validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and structured testing methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical escalations and make sound decisions where system availability, cybersecurity, safety, schedule, or customer commitments may be at risk.

* Experience operating effectively within a complex global matrix organization across multiple geographies, cultures, and time zones.

* Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business implications, recommendations, and decisions.

* Ability to travel internationally based on business and project requirements.

* Preferred Qualifications

* Advanced degree in a relevant engineering or technical discipline.

* Experience with utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS), renewable energy, power generation, transmission and distribution, or grid-connected infrastructure.

* Experience designing or supporting networks within utility, power generation, substation, or other critical infrastructure environments.

* Knowledge of applicable industrial cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, or comparable regional standards.

* Relevant professional certifications in networking, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, industrial control systems, or related disciplines.

* Experience building or scaling a global engineering Center of Excellence or specialized technical organization.

Experience establishing global engineering standards while accommodating regional grid, regulatory, customer, and cybersecurity requirements.  



**Our Culture**

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.

**Unleash Voices**

We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.

**Customer Fluent**

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.

**Infinite Impact**

We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.

**All In**

title: Director of Design
description:
About Mendocino Farms
  
At Mendocino Farms, we do a lot more than just sell sandwiches and salads. We are a fast-casual restaurant brand on a mission to bring people together through fresh, culinary-driven food and unmatched hospitality. As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory across new and existing markets, we are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and hands-on leader to elevate our total rewards structure.
  
Our Core Values and Mantras
  

* Sell Happy: The foundational philosophy that goes beyond serving meals to actively uplifting and improving every guest's day.
* Food Should Make People Feel Good: A commitment to using high-quality, whole, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients that make eating well easy.
* Be Culinary Explorers: A passion for combining fresh ingredients and bold flavors in unexpected, gourmet ways.
* Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.
* Get Better Every Day (GBED): An internal mantra encouraging continuous learning, personal growth, and skill development.

**Job Title:** Director of Design
  
**Reports To:** VP, Design & Construction
  
**Location:** Dallas, TX or Remote, USA
  
**Salary Range:** $117k - $190k (Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.)
  
  
**Summary:**  
Mendocino Farms is seeking a Director of Design to lead the evolution and delivery of our restaurant experience across new restaurants, remodels, refreshes, and strategic initiatives.
  
**This leader will own Mendo’s design function:** the restaurant prototype, design standards, internal and external design resources, and the systems that turn brand strategy into distinctive, functional, and scalable restaurants. You will partner closely with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, Real Estate, and Marketing to create environments that strengthen the guest experience while supporting efficient operations, disciplined investment, and growth.
  
This is an opportunity for a creative and operationally minded leader who can set a compelling design point of view, build a high-performing team and consultant network, and make practical decisions that balance quality, durability, speed, cost, and long-term unit performance as Mendocino Farms expands its restaurant footprint.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
Lead the design function
  

* Lead, coach, and develop internal designers and external design resources; set clear expectations, effective working rhythms, and a high bar for quality and accountability.
* Align internal and external design resources to the development pipeline, identifying when specialized expertise is needed.
* Serve as the senior design leader for complex, high-visibility, or high-risk projects and decisions.

Own the brand environment and design standards
  

* Own and evolve Mendo’s restaurant prototype, design standards, material palettes, finishes, furniture, fixtures, lighting, equipment integration, and reusable design details.
* Ensure every restaurant delivers a recognizable Mendo experience while adapting appropriately to site conditions, market needs, and business priorities.
* Use operating feedback, field learning, and market insight to keep the brand environment relevant, differentiated, and scalable.
* Set and elevate Mendo’s creative design point of view, translating brand strategy into memorable, functional restaurant environments that feel distinctive across markets and formats.

Improve restaurant operations through design
  

* Maintain and evolve design standards that prioritize guest flow, ordering and pickup, digital and delivery activity, seating, accessibility, storage, serviceability, and day-to-day operations.
* Partner with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, and equipment vendors to improve kitchen planning, back-of-house flow, equipment integration, team ergonomics, throughput, food safety, and maintainability.
* Incorporate post-opening learning into future layouts, prototypes, and specifications.

Drive quality, clarity, and design delivery
  

* Oversee design delivery for new restaurants, remodels, and refresh programs from feasibility test fits and concepts through permit-ready documentation and design-related construction support.
* Establish practical design QA/QC and phase-gate practices that produce complete, coordinated, code-aware, and timely deliverables.
* Lead cross-functional reviews using clear agendas, advance pre-reads, recommendations, concise decision requests, and thoroughly documented follow-through.
* Translate stakeholder input into clear direction for internal teams and consultants, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early.
* Partner with Construction to protect design intent, improve constructability, and reduce design-related rework, RFIs, and change orders.

Manage partners and investment decisions
  

* Select, brief, manage, and evaluate architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors; set clear expectations for scope, quality, timing, communication, and accountability.
* Partner with Construction and Real Estate to understand design cost drivers and make value-engineering recommendations.
* Balance brand expression, operating performance, durability, cost, schedule, and long-term unit economics in design and specification decisions.
* Track design-function performance, capacity, risks, and priorities; use post-project reviews to improve standards, tools, and partner performance.
* Develop the annual design operating plan in partnership with Real Estate, including internal and consultant capacity, priorities, budget needs, and key risks; provide regular updates on design delivery.

How you’ll lead at Mendo
  
You lead with ownership, preparation, sound judgment, and a continuous-improvement mindset. You develop people and partners, create alignment through clear communication and decision-making, navigate tradeoffs constructively, and build confidence through reliable follow-through.
  
  
**What you’ll bring:**  

* 10+ years of progressive experience in restaurant, retail, hospitality, architecture, interior design, or another related built-environment discipline.
* Experience leading a design team, studio, function, or substantial network of external design partners in a fast-moving, multi-project environment.
* Significant hands-on experience with restaurant or similarly operationally intensive commercial design, including prototype development, new-unit growth, remodels, and site-specific adaptation.
* Strong command of restaurant operations and design, including FOH/BOH flow, kitchen equipment, labor and ergonomics, guest circulation and accessibility, pickup/delivery, food safety, storage, and maintainability.
* Experience managing architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors against quality, schedule, scope, and budget expectations.
* Working knowledge of construction documentation, design QA/QC, permitting, building and health codes, design detailing, accessibility, shop-drawing review, and constructability.
* Financial fluency with design budgets, cost drivers, value engineering, specification tradeoffs, lifecycle durability, and unit economics.
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Environmental Design, Product Design, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu, Excel, PowerPoint, and project-management platforms; working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or Revit and SketchUp is preferred.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to develop concise recommendations and executive-ready presentations.
* Ability to travel occasionally for market visits, project milestones, and team meetings.

**Benefits include:**  

* Competitive salary
* Meal privileges
* Health benefits
* 401k Plan
* Paid Vacation

Physical Requirements
  

* Must be able to lift 25 pounds.
* Sitting / standing 6-8 hours.
* Hand use: single grasping, fine manipulation, pushing and pulling
* Work requires the following motions: bending, twisting, squatting and reaching

There is no “I” in Mendo

Mendocino Farms will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

title: Fractional Media Director
description:

We are seeking an autonomous, business-minded **Media Director** to take comprehensive ownership of our annual **$20M media budget**. As a $200-$250M omnichannel brand scaling rapidly, we are moving beyond pure-play performance to build a sophisticated, full-funnel media engine.

In this role, you will operate as a high-leverage individual contributor. Instead of managing a large internal team, you will wield full strategic control over media allocation and agency partners. You will be responsible for balancing traditional **DTC conversion media**, deploying our new **brand awareness initiatives**, and maximizing our presence across our core Retail Media Networks: **Amazon** and **Target**. Additionally, you will support us in hiring the right media agency/partner.

**Duties**

**1. Full Media Budget Ownership & Capital Allocation**

* Serve as the sole financial steward for the $XM media budget, fluidly shifting capital between performance, brand, and retail channels to maximize overall enterprise growth.

* Drive omni-channel velocity by building and scaling ad strategies on **Amazon Advertising** (Sponsored Ads, DSP) and **Target Roundel**.

* Own the strategy, deployment, and optimization of upper-funnel brand equity campaigns across Connected TV (CTV), Digital Audio, Linear, and Programmatic video.
* Establish and track upper-funnel success metrics via brand lift studies, tracking share of voice (SOV), and baseline organic search growth.

* Quantify the "halo effect" of brand and retail media spending on our direct-to-consumer website traffic and sales.

**Qualifications**

* **Budget Scale:** Direct experience managing or heavily influencing media budgets of **$20M+ annually**.

* **Individual Contributor DNA:** Thrives as a self-directed operator who can command a $50M budget and steer agencies without needing a large internal team to delegate to.
* **Full-Funnel Native:** Demonstrated success deploying and measuring upper-funnel, non-linear brand awareness campaigns.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Highly proficient in interpreting MMM data, Google Analytics 4, and multi-retailer dashboard metrics.

Join us as a Fractional Media Director if you're ready to bring your strategic vision to life through impactful storytelling, innovative media outreach, and engaging digital campaigns!

Pay: From $150.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is building Flow, a unified data security platform spanning Human Data Security, Agentic Data Security, and Data Security Posture Management. The people who use it are security analysts, insider-risk investigators, and data protection leaders — experts doing demanding work under time pressure, who live in our product all day. And increasingly they are not working alone: AI agents are becoming actors inside the enterprise and inside our product, which means the experience we design now has to serve both the human doing the judging and the agent doing the work.

We are looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and own what Flow feels like to use. You will set the experience vision for the platform, define the interaction patterns for a generation of security work that is part human and part agentic, and lead the designers and researchers who make it real.

You will lead a small, talented team of designers and will partner directly with the CPO, product management, engineering, and customer experience, and you will operate as the design voice in the rooms where the roadmap and scope get decided. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will raise the craft bar and grow your team, and still be close enough to the work to have an independent point of view about what we should build.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product design experience across Flow, HDS, ADS, and DSPM from the analyst’s daily workflow to how the platform holds together as one product rather than three.
* Define the next-generation experience vision for the platform, including how humans and AI agents work together inside it: agent-assisted investigation, human-in-the-loop decisions, explainability, and the interaction patterns that let a security professional trust and override automated work.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product designers, and raise the standard for craft, critique, and how design decisions are argued and defended.
* Own the UX research function and make sure the team’s work is grounded in evidence customer interviews, usability testing, support and RFE signal, and product instrumentation rather than internal opinion.
* Partner with product management and engineering from the earliest stage of every major initiative, shaping the problem definition and scope rather than styling decisions that have already been made.
* Build and evolve the design system and the patterns that let a growing engineering organization ship a consistent experience at speed.
* Establish how design measures itself usability benchmarks, task success, time to resolution for core analyst workflows, adoption of new surfaces, support deflection and report against it.
* Drive the experience work behind platform migration, making sure the move to Flow is something customers want rather than something they endure.
* Represent the customer’s experience in executive forums roadmap reviews, business reviews, and planning with a clear and honest read on where the product stands.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years leading and developing designers, with a portfolio of shipped work you can walk through end to end.
* You have set an experience vision for a complex product and then delivered against it — not just a concept deck, but patterns and surfaces that shipped and held up.
* Experienced with complex, expert-user enterprise software — tools where the user is a professional doing demanding work, not a consumer. Security, IT operations, observability, data infrastructure, or similar domains.
* You have designed AI-powered or agentic product experiences and have a real point of view on trust, transparency, control, and what happens when the model is wrong.
* Strong systems thinker: you can hold a platform-level information architecture in your head, and you build design systems that make teams faster instead of slowing them down.
* You value and use research. You know how to run the function, ask the right questions of it, and act on what comes back.
* An exceptional communicator and influencer. You can tell a room of executives something they do not want to hear, ground it in the customer’s reality, and leave with a decision.
* A people leader first. You develop designers, give direct feedback, and build a team that does its best work.
* You operate with urgency and judgment in a fast-moving environment, and you are comfortable making progress before every input is in hand.
* Located in the US (SF Bay Area preferred).

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Worked in cybersecurity, or designed for security operations, insider risk, or data protection teams.
* Led design through a major platform migration or the consolidation of several products into one.
* Experience building a design function hiring, leveling, process, and the operating rhythm not just running one that already existed.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

**AI Tools Disclosure:** As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

Compensation Range: $250K - $275K
