title: Director of Social
description:
US - Remote

Brand

Remote

Full-time

### **Company Overview**

Function is how you manage your lifelong health. The mission is to empower 8 billion people to live 100 healthy years.

We've created a new category in health. Named a TIME100 Most Influential Company. Raised $350M from investors ranging from a16z to Kevin Hart. We started with lab testing three years ago and are quickly building a full-stack health system.

  

Function now reaches over a million people owning their health in a new way — far beyond biohackers and health nuts. It's popular coast to coast, across a wide range of incomes. Function is $1 a day, for what could otherwise cost thousands and be accessible only to a select few.

  

We're growing our team very selectively. World-class talent only. You must be driven by the mission to materially impact how people live globally.

  

The right person has a bias toward action and a growth mindset. There's no time to waste, and hard work is required. The reward is career-defining purpose and upside.

  

### **Role**

Social media is the fabric of culture. And it's the frontier of our GTM at Function. It's about attention, but also trust: make people feel something, and know they must have Function for themselves and their loved ones.

  

This role will own social channels and community end-to-end, and will partner closely with the leader who owns creator and influencer. This is one of the most visible and consequential roles at Function. It directly shapes how the world sees us, who advocates for us, and how we grow. You'll lead a small team spanning social, content, and community, and work in close collaboration with creative, comms, and the creator and influencer team.

  

You can take a single story and tell it in countless compelling ways. You read culture the way a strategist does and execute the way an operator does. You understand not just what's trending but why, and you use that behavioral intelligence to make decisions that are defensible and ahead of the curve. You know when to show up in a cultural moment and when to create one. You make the creator and influencer team's work stronger, and you know the difference between influence and noise.

  

If you've scaled a social presence, built AI into how the work gets done, and can point to the cultural reads behind it, keep reading.

  

### **What You'll Own**

#### **Social Strategy and Execution at Scale**

* Full ownership of multi-channel social growth.
* Drive step-changes in reach, engagement, and cultural relevance. Incremental is not the goal.
* Build and execute an always-on, performance-driven social strategy that keeps the brand sacred while enabling experimentation.
* Translate company priorities into platform-native content and formats across Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, Threads, and Facebook.
* Bring a maker mentality. Partner with creative and other teams to make the work, and be comfortable concepting, creating, and shipping it yourself.
* Personally model best-in-class real-time engagement: on-brand, fast, human, and culturally aware. Walk the walk.
* Set the creative bar with exceptional taste and cultural judgment. Be original in formats and moments, not reactive to what's already saturated.

#### **AI-Native Social & Community**

* Design and deploy AI agents and workflows that manage community engagement at scale: listening, triage, response, and follow-through.
* Use AI to multiply what a small team can make: ideation, production, versioning, trend detection, creator discovery, and reporting.
* Decide what agents handle and what a person must handle, so brand voice and trust hold as volume grows.
* Keep testing new tools and ways of working. Keep what earns its place and drop what doesn't.

#### **Creator & Influencer Partnership**

* Partner with the leader of creator and influencer so social and creator run as one cultural strategy, with shared calendars, briefs, and moments.
* Turn creator and talent content into platform-native social, and give that team the cultural reads and formats that help their work land.
* Bring a cultural lens to partnership fit: does this person reflect where health culture is heading, or where it's been?
* Work with growth and performance teams so social drives measurable acquisition outcomes, not just reach.

#### **Cultural Intelligence & Trend Leadership**

* Obsess over where culture is heading in 12 to 24 months.
* Decode the behavioral "why" behind audience actions: what they engage with, who they trust, how health fits into their identity, and where Function has permission to show up.
* Identify cultural moments worth owning, define the moments Function should build, and set the criteria for knowing when they've landed.
* Apply cultural intelligence to platform strategy, content direction, and input on ambassador selection — removing subjectivity from creative feedback and grounding decisions in real signal.
* Map the cultural tensions Function navigates as it scales (access vs. luxury, data empowerment vs. health-tech skepticism) and help the brand move through them with intention.

#### **Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop a small team across social, content, and community.
* Set the direction, operating model, and performance standards for the team.
* Build an AI-native operating model that lets a small team produce the output of a much larger one.

#### **Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Collaborate closely and daily with creative, comms, and the creator and influencer team. Share ideas early and share credit.
* Communicate clearly on performance, cultural rationale, and strategic direction.

#### **Performance & Accountability**

* Define metrics that matter across social and community. Be accountable.
* Tie cultural and social work to business outcomes.
* Move fast without being sloppy. Own your calls and your numbers.
  

  

### **The Bar**

#### **You likely have**

* Up to about 10 years of experience owning social strategy, content, and community. Recency matters more than tenure: extensive, recent AI-native experience can balance fewer years.
* Hands-on AI-native experience in social. You've activated AI across the work, including agents that manage community engagement, and can show the results.
* Recent, compelling social activations you can walk us through: the idea, how you made it, and what it did.
* Experience at culture brands, including creating something out of nothing in the earliest days.
* A history of highly collaborative work with creative, comms, talent, and creator teams.
* A proven track record of meaningful channel growth that drove real business outcomes.
* Experience leading and developing a small team.
* Deep operating experience in real time: cultural moments, news cycles, launches, live engagement.
* A genuine cultural intelligence practice — you can explain not just what performed, but why, and what it signals about where the audience is heading.
* Strong analytical instincts and fluency tying social performance to growth metrics.
  

  

#### **You are**

* A maker at heart. You partner well with teams, and you're comfortable making it happen yourself.
* Passionate about helping 8 billion people live 100 healthy years.
* Biased toward action, now.
* Someone with great taste and sound judgment.
* Highly collaborative. People in creative, comms, and creator want to work with you again.
* Fast, decisive, and comfortable being accountable in public.
* Detail-obsessed, but not precious.
* Equally comfortable in strategy decks and in the comments section.
* Opinionated about culture and curious about what's driving it.
* A builder of teams, systems, and trust.
  

  

### **To be a strong fit, you embody our Core Values:**

* ***Ruthless Prioritization:***
  + We don’t let perfect get in the way of progress.
  + We move quickly to drive value, not perfection.
  + We prioritize what drives impact.
  + We never compromise on standards of excellence.
* ***Member-First, Always:***
  + We design and deliver like we’re caring for someone we love.
  + We create clear, actionable, human experiences.
  + We prioritize responsiveness, peace of mind, and outcomes.
  + We empower members with truth, clarity, and care.
* ***One Team, Moving Fast:***
  + We are aligned in purpose, prioritization, and speed.
  + We gather diverse perspectives to make informed decisions.
  + We clear paths for each other and move fast together.
  + We communicate clearly and respectfully, rallying around shared goals.
* ***Radical Ownership, Relentless Execution:***
  + We don’t just ship—we own outcomes and drive results.
  + We act with urgency and precision.
  + We anticipate, initiate, and follow through.
  + We meet challenges with grit and pragmatism.
  + We embrace new tech to deliver better outcomes.
* ***Mission Over Ego:***
  + We are ruthlessly aligned to our mission—and leave ego at the door.
  + We disagree and commit.
  + We don't tolerate politics or withholding information.
  + We operate with honesty, transparency, and respect.
* ***Sustained Integrity in Every Detail:***
  + We earn trust by obsessing over accuracy, quality, and clarity in everything we do
  + We prioritize clinical precision—data must be right.
  + We sweat the details because outcomes depend on them.

  

### **Why You'll Love Working With Us:**

We value our team at Function and offer a competitive salary and benefits package, flexible working hours, and a dynamic work environment where creativity and innovation are encouraged. If you are a highly motivated and experienced individual who is passionate about using technology to improve people’s lives, we would love to hear from you.

  

At Function, we celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workforce. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, ancestry, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  

Join the Function Health team and become a part of our mission to revolutionize healthcare. Work with us to make a difference in the lives of thousands, ensuring a healthier future for all. Discover more about us and how we're changing the face of healthcare at Function Health.

  

***Important Notice:*** *Legitimate communication from the Function Health team will always come from an email address ending in**@functionhealth.com**.* *Function Health will never request personal information such as banking details or payment during the hiring process. Please be cautious of communications or job offers that come from other email domains, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls. If you ever have doubts about the legitimacy of a communication, please reach out to us directly at**talent@functionhealth.com**.*

title: VFX Director
description:
Studio Wildcard, creators of the hit game ARK, was founded in 2014 by industry veterans Jeremy Stieglitz and Jesse Rapczak. ARK is the most successful Steam Early Access and Xbox Game Preview title ever and continues to break industry records on consoles and PC. We are seeking an experienced and highly creative VFX Director to lead the visual effects vision across our games and cinematic experiences. This role will define the artistic direction, technical standards, and production workflows for real-time visual effects while collaborating closely with Art, Engineering, Design, Animation, Cinematics, and Production teams.

The ideal candidate is both a strong visual leader and an experienced VFX artist who understands how to create spectacular and performant effects for large-scale game worlds in Unreal.

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain the overall VFX artistic vision and quality bar for Studio Wildcard projects.
* Lead and mentor a team of VFX artists, providing creative direction, feedback, and professional development.
* Develop VFX style guides, visual standards, workflows, and production best practices.
* Collaborate with Art Director, Creative Director, Designers, Animators, Engineers, and Cinematics teams to develop cohesive visual experiences.
* Oversee the creation of gameplay VFX including environmental effects, abilities, weapons, creatures, destruction, weather, magic, explosions, and other interactive effects.
* Ensure VFX assets meet performance, scalability, readability, and platform requirements.
* Work closely with Technical Artists and Engineers to improve VFX tools, shaders, materials, particle systems, and pipelines.
* Establish efficient review and iteration processes for VFX production.
* Balance visual quality with gameplay readability and technical performance.
* Participate in creative reviews and provide clear, actionable feedback to artists.
* Help define staffing, scheduling, task prioritization, and resource requirements for VFX production.
* Identify emerging VFX technologies and techniques that could improve the quality and efficiency of Studio Wildcard's projects.
* Maintain awareness of current real-time rendering, simulation, procedural, and cinematic VFX techniques.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of professional experience creating VFX for AAA games, film, animation, or comparable real-time entertainment.
* Previous experience leading or directing a VFX team.
* Strong understanding of real-time VFX production and Unreal 5+.
* Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain a cohesive visual style across a large project.
* Strong artistic understanding of color, composition, timing, motion, lighting, scale, and visual storytelling.
* Experience with particle systems, shaders/materials, textures, animation, simulations, and procedural effects.
* Strong understanding of performance optimization and real-time rendering constraints.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to provide clear artistic feedback while maintaining a positive and creative team environment.
* Experience working across multiple disciplines in a game-development environment.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality VFX work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Unreal Engine and/or other modern real-time engines.
* Experience creating VFX for large open-world or multiplayer games.
* Experience with creature, environmental, elemental, weather, destruction, and combat VFX.
* Experience directing cinematic VFX and trailer work.
* Familiarity with Niagara, Houdini, Substance tools, or comparable procedural/VFX technologies.
* Experience building or improving VFX production pipelines and tools.
* Experience working with technical artists and graphics programmers.
* Passion for dinosaurs, creatures, survival games, science fiction, fantasy, or large-scale worlds.

**What You'll Bring**

We are looking for a VFX leader who can think beyond individual effects and help define the visual language of an entire game.

You should be comfortable moving between high-level creative direction and detailed artistic feedback. You understand when an effect needs to be spectacular, when it needs to be subtle, and—most importantly—when it needs to communicate clearly to the player.

You will have a major influence on how players experience the world, from the smallest environmental details to massive creature encounters and world-changing events.

**Leadership Expectations**

As VFX Director, you will:

* Set a clear creative vision for the VFX team.
* Build and maintain a strong artistic culture.
* Mentor artists and help develop the next generation of VFX talent.
* Champion experimentation while maintaining production discipline.
* Establish quality standards and hold the team accountable to them.
* Work collaboratively across departments rather than operating in isolation.
* Be proactive when gathering design requirements for VFX tasks
* Advocate for VFX team during production planning and technical development.
* Help create a team environment where artists can take creative risks, iterate, and produce their best work.

**Portfolio Requirements**

Applicants should provide a portfolio or reel demonstrating:

* Real-time gameplay VFX
* Combat or ability effects
* Environmental effects
* Creature or character effects
* Large-scale effects and simulations
* Shader/material work where applicable
* Cinematic VFX where applicable

**Why Studio Wildcard**

At Studio Wildcard, VFX plays a critical role in bringing expansive worlds, creatures, environments, and gameplay systems to life. The VFX Director will have the opportunity to help establish the visual identity of our projects while working alongside a multidisciplinary team of worldclass artists, designers, engineers, and developers.

If you're passionate about creating unforgettable real-time visual experiences and want to help push the boundaries of game VFX, we'd love to see your work.

**Required Application Materials:**

* Resume
* Portfolio
* Cover Letter which should include
  + Why you are interested in working for Studio Wildcard
  + What games you are currently playing

* Experience mentoring and developing design managers, senior designers, and future design leaders against clear level expectations.

title: Director Architecture, Design & Construction - Lifestyle
description:
### **Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

*This role is based at one of our corporate offices in McLean, VA, New York, NY or Remote*

This is your chance to be part of an in-house Architecture, Design & Construction team that delivers exceptional properties that delight our guests, reward our partners, and reflect the unique cultures of their geographical locations!

Lifestyle hotels are shaped by more than great design, they capture the character of their destinations, create meaningful connections and deliver experiences guests want to return to. This is an opportunity for a commercially astute, design-literate hospitality project leader to help bring these distinctive hotels to life across North America as part of Hilton's in-house Architecture, Design & Construction (AD&C) team.

As Director, Architecture Design & Construction - Lifestyle, reporting to the Senior Director of Architecture, Design & Construction – Lifestyle, you will shape Hilton's next generation of Lifestyle hotels across North America. You will lead projects from early vision through opening, working with owners, developers, Brand and consultants to elevate design and delivery.

You will bring strong project management experience, Lifestyle expertise across hospitality, design and F&B, and the confidence to lead and influence. Success requires urgency and a proactive mindset: anticipating challenges, removing obstacles and getting things done.

**What you'll do during a typical day:**

* Provide technical and construction leadership across all development phases.
* Review design and construction documents for alignment with Hilton requirements and project ambitions.
* Influence decisions to strengthen design, brand expression, operational performance and commercial value.
* Conduct site inspections, identify risks and drive prompt resolution.
* Champion Lifestyle experiences informed by design, F&B, and cultural trends.
* Travel 40–50% for owner meetings, design reviews, site inspections and openings across North America.

**How you'll collaborate with others:**

* Strengthen an inclusive, high-performing AD&C culture by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and raising the bar.
* Build long-term trust with owners, positioning Hilton as a strategic partner of choice.
* Partner with Development to support growth and secure the right projects.
* Translate Brand vision into culturally relevant and commercially successful hotels.
* Partner with AD&C Design to elevate design quality, guest experience and food and beverage.
* Unite internal teams around shared priorities, driving decisions and successful openings.

**Projects** **you'll take ownership of:**

* Take full ownership of developments, conversions, adaptive-reuse projects and brand changes, serving as Hilton's project lead from pre-signing through opening.
* Establish project vision, delivery strategy, milestones and accountabilities.

* Guide value engineering without compromising design quality or guest experience.
* Anticipate risks, remove obstacles and drive decisions with urgency.

* Design, construction or renovation experience in hospitality, particularly Lifestyle-branded hotels
* Willing to travel up to 40 - 50%

* Professional licenses or certifications such as Architect, Engineer, Interior Designer (NCIDQ) or Project Management Professional (PMP)

Experience with Bluebeam.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
  
  
**Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.**
****💛 EOE****
Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
